package com.music.bitchord

import com.music.bitchord.ui.player.LyricClock
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.random.Random
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class LyricClockTest {
    private val frameMs = 1000.0 / 60

    /**
     * A song playing at [rate] from [startMs], read every 500 ms. Each reading
     * is stamped when it is taken, and then reaches the frame loop up to
     * [maxDelayMs] later — the way a reading did when the main thread was busy
     * with the recomposition that reading itself had caused.
     */
    private class Playback(
        val startMs: Long = 44_500L,
        val rate: Double = 1.0,
        val maxDelayMs: Double = 60.0,
        val stamped: Boolean = true,
        seed: Int = 7,
    ) {
        private val random = Random(seed)
        private var nextPollMs = 0.0
        private val inFlight = ArrayDeque<Pair<Double, Pair<Long, Double>>>()
        var report: Long = startMs
            private set
        var sampledAt: Double = if (stamped) 0.0 else Double.NaN
            private set

        fun trueAt(nowMs: Double) = startMs + nowMs * rate

        /** Advances deliveries to [nowMs]; afterwards [report] and [sampledAt] are what the frame sees. */
        fun deliver(nowMs: Double) {
            while (nextPollMs <= nowMs) {
                val reading = trueAt(nextPollMs).toLong()
                val arrives = nextPollMs + random.nextDouble() * maxDelayMs
                inFlight.addLast(arrives to (reading to nextPollMs))
                nextPollMs += 500.0
            }
            while (inFlight.isNotEmpty() && inFlight.first().first <= nowMs) {
                val (reading, at) = inFlight.removeFirst().second
                report = reading
                if (stamped) sampledAt = at
            }
        }
    }

    private class Run(val frames: List<Double>, val shown: List<Long>, val truth: List<Double>)

    /** Frames at 60 Hz, with a stall of up to [maxStallMs] — no frames at all — now and then. */
    private fun run(playback: Playback, seconds: Double, maxStallMs: Double = 0.0, seed: Int = 11): Run {
        val random = Random(seed)
        val clock = LyricClock(playback.startMs)
        val frames = ArrayList<Double>()
        val shown = ArrayList<Long>()
        val truth = ArrayList<Double>()
        var now = 0.0
        while (now <= seconds * 1000) {
            playback.deliver(now)
            frames += now
            shown += clock.frame(now, playback.report, playback.sampledAt, discontinuity = 0)
            truth += playback.trueAt(now)
            now += frameMs
            if (maxStallMs > 0 && random.nextDouble() < 0.02) now += random.nextDouble() * maxStallMs
        }
        return Run(frames, shown, truth)
    }

    private fun assertNeverBack(run: Run) {
        for (i in 1 until run.shown.size) {
            assertTrue("went back at ${run.frames[i]}", run.shown[i] >= run.shown[i - 1])
        }
    }

    /** The bug: readings held up behind a busy main thread rolled the words back. */
    @Test fun lateReadingsNeverMoveTheWordsBack() {
        val run = run(Playback(maxDelayMs = 800.0), seconds = 90.0, maxStallMs = 600.0)
        assertNeverBack(run)
    }

    @Test fun lateReadingsDoNotPullTheWordsOffTheSong() {
        val run = run(Playback(maxDelayMs = 800.0), seconds = 60.0, maxStallMs = 600.0)
        for (i in run.frames.indices) {
            if (run.frames[i] < 2_000) continue
            val error = run.shown[i] - run.truth[i]
            assertTrue("off by $error at ${run.frames[i]}", abs(error) < 40.0)
        }
    }

    /** The earlier bug: a `maxOf` ratchet froze the words for up to a second. */
    @Test fun lateReadingsNeverStallTheWords() {
        val run = run(Playback(maxDelayMs = 800.0), seconds = 60.0)
        val window = 15
        for (i in window until run.shown.size) {
            val moved = run.shown[i] - run.shown[i - window]
            val elapsed = run.frames[i] - run.frames[i - window]
            assertTrue("stalled near ${run.frames[i]}: $moved ms in $elapsed", moved >= elapsed * 0.5)
        }
    }

    /** A source that cannot stamp its readings still never goes backwards. */
    @Test fun unstampedReadingsNeverMoveTheWordsBack() {
        val run = run(Playback(maxDelayMs = 800.0, stamped = false), seconds = 60.0, maxStallMs = 600.0)
        assertNeverBack(run)
    }

    @Test fun learnsAFasterPlaybackRate() {
        val run = run(Playback(rate = 1.25, maxDelayMs = 300.0), seconds = 30.0)
        for (i in run.frames.indices) {
            if (run.frames[i] < 4_000) continue
            val error = run.shown[i] - run.truth[i]
            assertTrue("off by $error at ${run.frames[i]}", abs(error) < 40.0)
        }
        assertNeverBack(run)
    }

    /** Drives a clock on a song at 1x from 10 s, with [readingAt] deciding what each 500 ms reading says. */
    private fun steady(
        until: Double,
        clock: LyricClock = LyricClock(10_000),
        discontinuity: (Double) -> Long = { 0L },
        readingAt: (Double) -> Long = { 10_000 + it.toLong() },
        onFrame: (now: Double, shown: Long) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
    ): Long {
        var now = 0.0
        var shown = 0L
        while (now <= until) {
            val taken = (now / 500).toLong() * 500.0
            shown = clock.frame(now, readingAt(taken), taken, discontinuity(now))
            onFrame(now, shown)
            now += frameMs
        }
        return shown
    }

    @Test fun oneWrongReadingIsIgnored() {
        var previous = Long.MIN_VALUE
        val last = steady(until = 8_000.0, readingAt = { taken ->
            10_000 + taken.toLong() + when (taken) {
                3_000.0 -> 1_500
                5_000.0 -> -1_500
                else -> 0
            }
        }) { now, shown ->
            assertTrue("went back at $now", shown >= previous)
            if (now > 1_000) assertTrue("followed the bad reading at $now", abs(shown - (10_000 + now)) < 40)
            previous = shown
        }
        assertTrue(abs(last - 18_000) < 40)
    }

    /** Tapping the line before this one: an announced jump, rolled back to rather than cut. */
    @Test fun announcedBackwardSeekGlidesBackAndLands() {
        var shown = 0L
        var largestStep = 0L
        val seekAt = 4_000.0
        steady(
            until = 5_000.0,
            discontinuity = { if (it >= seekAt) 1L else 0L },
            readingAt = { taken -> 10_000 + taken.toLong() - if (taken >= seekAt) 1_000 else 0 },
        ) { now, next ->
            if (now > seekAt) largestStep = maxOf(largestStep, abs(next - shown))
            shown = next
        }
        assertTrue("cut rather than glided: $largestStep ms in a frame", largestStep < 150)
        assertTrue("never landed: $shown", abs(shown - 14_000) < 40)
    }

    @Test fun announcedFarSeekJumpsAtOnce() {
        val clock = LyricClock(30_000)
        clock.frame(0.0, 30_000, 0.0, 0)
        clock.frame(16.0, 30_000, 0.0, 0)
        assertEquals(4_003L, clock.frame(33.0, 4_000, 30.0, 1))
    }

    /** The song really moved back without saying so: the words slow down to meet it, never reverse. */
    @Test fun unannouncedSmallRewindSlowsDownInsteadOfReversing() {
        var previous = Long.MIN_VALUE
        val last = steady(
            until = 12_000.0,
            readingAt = { taken -> 10_000 + taken.toLong() - if (taken >= 4_000) 800 else 0 },
        ) { now, shown ->
            assertTrue("went back at $now", shown >= previous)
            previous = shown
        }
        assertTrue("never met the song: $last", abs(last - (22_000 - 800)) < 40)
    }

    @Test fun unannouncedFarJumpIsFollowed() {
        val last = steady(
            until = 8_000.0,
            readingAt = { taken -> 10_000 + taken.toLong() - if (taken >= 4_000) 20_000 else 0 },
        )
        assertTrue("stayed lost: $last", abs(last - (18_000 - 20_000)) < 40)
    }

    @Test fun unannouncedForwardJumpCatchesUp() {
        var previous = Long.MIN_VALUE
        val last = steady(
            until = 8_000.0,
            readingAt = { taken -> 10_000 + taken.toLong() + if (taken >= 4_000) 1_000 else 0 },
        ) { now, shown ->
            assertTrue("went back at $now", shown >= previous)
            previous = shown
        }
        assertTrue(abs(last - 19_000) < 40)
    }

    @Test fun holdSettlesAtOnce() {
        val clock = LyricClock(10_000)
        clock.frame(0.0, 10_000, 0.0, 0)
        clock.frame(400.0, 10_400, 400.0, 0)
        clock.hold(10_380, 420.0)
        assertEquals(10_380.0, clock.displayedMs, 0.0)
    }

    /** A reading taken before a pause is where the song still is when it resumes, however long ago. */
    @Test fun resumingAfterAPauseStartsWhereItStopped() {
        val clock = LyricClock(10_000)
        clock.frame(0.0, 10_000, 0.0, 0)
        clock.hold(10_000, 5.0)
        clock.restart()
        assertEquals(10_000L, clock.frame(60_000.0, 10_000, 0.0, 0))
        assertEquals(10_016L, clock.frame(60_016.0, 10_000, 0.0, 0))
    }

    /** Coming back to the app while it played on: the last reading has moved on by its age. */
    @Test fun returningToTheAppExtrapolatesFromTheLastReading() {
        val clock = LyricClock(10_000)
        clock.frame(0.0, 10_000, 0.0, 0)
        clock.restart()
        assertEquals(40_000L, clock.frame(30_000.0, 10_000, 0.0, 0))
    }

    /** Moving the lyrics offset shifts every reading at once; announced, it is a jump and not a fault. */
    @Test fun movingTheOffsetIsFollowed() {
        val last = steady(
            until = 5_000.0,
            discontinuity = { if (it >= 3_000) 1L else 0L },
            readingAt = { taken -> 10_000 + taken.toLong() - if (taken >= 3_000) 1_500 else 0 },
        )
        assertTrue(abs(last - (15_000 - 1_500)) < 40)
    }
}

package com.music.bitchord

import com.music.bitchord.data.lyrics.LyricLine
import com.music.bitchord.ui.player.activeLyricRows
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class LyricFocusTest {
    private val overlap = listOf(
        LyricLine(1_000, "upper", sungUntilMs = 4_000),
        LyricLine(2_000, "middle", sungUntilMs = 5_000),
        LyricLine(3_000, "lower", sungUntilMs = 6_000),
    )

    @Test fun upperLineKeepsAnchorAcrossThreeOverlappingVocals() {
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 1, 2), activeLyricRows(overlap, 3_500))
    }

    @Test fun anchorAdvancesExactlyWhenUpperVocalEnds() {
        assertEquals(listOf(1, 2), activeLyricRows(overlap, 4_000))
        assertEquals(listOf(2), activeLyricRows(overlap, 5_000))
    }

    @Test fun finishedMiddleRowDoesNotCutOffLongUpperVocal() {
        val lines = overlap.toMutableList()
        lines[1] = lines[1].copy(sungUntilMs = 2_900)
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 2), activeLyricRows(lines, 3_500))
    }

    @Test fun backgroundVocalKeepsItsParentRowAnchored() {
        val lines = listOf(
            LyricLine(1_000, "lead", sungUntilMs = 1_900,
                background = LyricLine(1_500, "echo", sungUntilMs = 3_000)),
            LyricLine(2_000, "next", sungUntilMs = 4_000),
        )
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 1), activeLyricRows(lines, 2_500))
        assertEquals(listOf(1), activeLyricRows(lines, 3_000))
    }

    @Test fun plainLrcAdvancesWithoutInventingAnOverlap() {
        val lines = overlap.map { it.copy(sungUntilMs = null) }
        assertEquals(listOf(1), activeLyricRows(lines, 2_500))
    }

    @Test fun backwardSeekRecomputesTheAnchor() {
        assertEquals(listOf(2), activeLyricRows(overlap, 5_500))
        assertEquals(listOf(0), activeLyricRows(overlap, 1_500))
        assertEquals(emptyList<Int>(), activeLyricRows(overlap, 500))
    }
}

package com.music.bitchord

import com.music.bitchord.ui.player.adjustedLyricsPosition
import com.music.bitchord.ui.player.adjustedLyricsSeekTarget

import org.junit.Test

class LyricsOffsetTest {
    @Test
    fun `positive offset delays lyrics`() {
        assertEquals(8_500L, adjustedLyricsPosition(positionMs = 10_000L, offsetMs = 1_500))
    }

    @Test
    fun `negative offset advances lyrics`() {
        assertEquals(11_500L, adjustedLyricsPosition(positionMs = 10_000L, offsetMs = -1_500))
    }

    @Test
    fun `offset never produces a negative lyric clock`() {
        assertEquals(0L, adjustedLyricsPosition(positionMs = 500L, offsetMs = 1_500))
    }

    @Test
    fun `seeking a lyric includes its offset`() {
        assertEquals(11_500L, adjustedLyricsSeekTarget(lineTimeMs = 10_000L, offsetMs = 1_500))
        assertEquals(8_500L, adjustedLyricsSeekTarget(lineTimeMs = 10_000L, offsetMs = -1_500))
    }
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { LyricClock } from './clock';

// Ported from the native app's LyricClockTest.kt.

const FRAME_MS = 1000 / 60;

/** A small seeded generator, so a failure reproduces. */
function seeded(seed: number): () => number {
  let state = seed >>> 0 || 1;
  return () => {
    state = (state * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
    return state / 2 ** 32;
  };
}

/** A song read every 500 ms, each reading stamped when taken and delivered up to [maxDelayMs] later. */
class Playback {
  report: number;
  sampledAt: number;
  private nextPollMs = 0;
  private inFlight: { arrives: number; reading: number; at: number }[] = [];
  private random: () => number;

  constructor(
    readonly startMs = 44_500,
    readonly rate = 1,
    readonly maxDelayMs = 60,
    readonly stamped = true,
    seed = 7,
  ) {
    this.report = startMs;
    this.sampledAt = stamped ? 0 : Number.NaN;
    this.random = seeded(seed);
  }

  trueAt(nowMs: number) {
    return this.startMs + nowMs * this.rate;
  }

  deliver(nowMs: number) {
    while (this.nextPollMs <= nowMs) {
      this.inFlight.push({
        arrives: this.nextPollMs + this.random() * this.maxDelayMs,
        reading: Math.trunc(this.trueAt(this.nextPollMs)),
        at: this.nextPollMs,
      });
      this.nextPollMs += 500;
    }
    this.inFlight.sort((a, b) => a.arrives - b.arrives);
    while (this.inFlight.length && this.inFlight[0]!.arrives <= nowMs) {
      const { reading, at } = this.inFlight.shift()!;
      this.report = reading;
      if (this.stamped) this.sampledAt = at;
    }
  }
}

function run(playback: Playback, seconds: number, maxStallMs = 0, seed = 11) {
  const random = seeded(seed);
  const clock = new LyricClock(playback.startMs);
  const frames: number[] = [];
  const shown: number[] = [];
  const truth: number[] = [];
  let now = 0;
  while (now <= seconds * 1000) {
    playback.deliver(now);
    frames.push(now);
    shown.push(clock.frame(now, playback.report, playback.sampledAt, 0));
    truth.push(playback.trueAt(now));
    now += FRAME_MS;
    if (maxStallMs > 0 && random() < 0.02) now += random() * maxStallMs;
  }
  return { frames, shown, truth };
}

function neverBack({ frames, shown }: ReturnType<typeof run>) {
  for (let i = 1; i < shown.length; i++) {
    if (shown[i]! < shown[i - 1]!) throw new Error(`went back at ${frames[i]}`);
  }
}

describe('LyricClock', () => {
  for (const seed of [7, 19, 42, 101, 2024]) {
    it(`never moves the words back on late readings (seed ${seed})`, () => {
      neverBack(run(new Playback(44_500, 1, 800, true, seed), 90, 600, seed + 4));
    });
  }

  it('keeps late readings from pulling the words off the song', () => {
    const r = run(new Playback(44_500, 1, 800), 60, 600);
    r.frames.forEach((at, i) => {
      if (at < 2000) return;
      expect(Math.abs(r.shown[i]! - r.truth[i]!)).toBeLessThan(40);
    });
  });

  it('never stalls the words', () => {
    const r = run(new Playback(44_500, 1, 800), 60);
    const window = 15;
    for (let i = window; i < r.shown.length; i++) {
      const moved = r.shown[i]! - r.shown[i - window]!;
      const elapsed = r.frames[i]! - r.frames[i - window]!;
      expect(moved).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(elapsed * 0.5);
    }
  });

  it('never goes back on unstamped readings', () => {
    neverBack(run(new Playback(44_500, 1, 800, false), 60, 600));
  });

  it('learns a faster playback rate', () => {
    const r = run(new Playback(44_500, 1.25, 300), 30);
    r.frames.forEach((at, i) => {
      if (at < 4000) return;
      expect(Math.abs(r.shown[i]! - r.truth[i]!)).toBeLessThan(40);
    });
    neverBack(r);
  });

  it('jumps on an announced seek', () => {
    const clock = new LyricClock(10_000);
    let now = 0;
    let shown = 0;
    while (now <= 3000) {
      const taken = Math.floor(now / 500) * 500;
      shown = clock.frame(now, 10_000 + taken, taken, 0);
      now += FRAME_MS;
    }
    // Seek to 60 s, announced.
    const seekAt = now;
    while (now <= seekAt + 1000) {
      const taken = Math.floor(now / 500) * 500;
      shown = clock.frame(now, 60_000 + Math.max(0, taken - seekAt), Math.max(taken, seekAt), 1);
      now += FRAME_MS;
    }
    expect(Math.abs(shown - (60_000 + (now - FRAME_MS - seekAt)))).toBeLessThan(100);
  });
});

File: web/app/src/lyrics/clock.ts

/**
 * The lyric playhead: a clock that runs on its own frames and is *steered* by
 * the player's readings rather than set by them. A verbatim port of the
 * native app's LyricClock.kt, which fixed
 * every "stuck" and "back-and-forth" lyric bug the apps had:
 *
 *  1. A reading is dated by when it was taken, not when it was seen.
 *  2. Nothing but an announced jump moves the words backwards.
 *  3. Readings steer, they don't set: the words close the gap to the newest
 *     reading carried forward at the learned rate, at most 25 % faster or
 *     50 % slower.
 *
 * All times are milliseconds on the `performance.now()` clock.
 */
export class LyricClock {
  /** Where the lyrics are drawn, in song milliseconds. */
  displayedMs: number;

  private lastNowMs = Number.NaN;
  private lastReportMs = Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER;
  private lastSampledAtMs = Number.NaN;
  /** When playback was last seen stopped; a reading taken before then was taken standing still. */
  private heldAtMs = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  private lastDiscontinuity: number | null = null;
  private jumpPending = false;
  private anchorAtMs = Number.NaN;
  private anchorMs = 0;
  /** The playback rate, learned from how far the song moves between readings. */
  private rate = 1;
  private historyAt: number[] = [];
  private historyMs: number[] = [];
  private rateSettled = false;
  private suspectAtMs = Number.NaN;
  private suspectMs = 0;
  private rejections = 0;
  private glideStartMs = Number.NaN;
  private glideOffsetMs = 0;

  constructor(startMs: number) {
    this.displayedMs = startMs;
  }

  /** Forget the run so far: frames stopped arriving, and the next frame starts a new one. */
  restart(): void {
    this.lastNowMs = Number.NaN;
    this.jumpPending = false;
    this.glideStartMs = Number.NaN;
    this.clearSuspect();
  }

  /** Playback is not moving: settle on [positionMs] outright, as of [nowMs]. */
  hold(positionMs: number, nowMs: number): void {
    this.restart();
    this.displayedMs = positionMs;
    this.heldAtMs = nowMs;
  }

  /**
   * Advance to the frame at [nowMs] and return where the lyrics should be drawn.
   * [sampledAtMs] is when [reportedMs] was taken (NaN when unknown);
   * [discontinuity] changes whenever the playhead jumps on purpose.
   */
  frame(nowMs: number, reportedMs: number, sampledAtMs: number, discontinuity: number): number {
    const firstOfRun = Number.isNaN(this.lastNowMs);
    if (discontinuity !== this.lastDiscontinuity) {
      if (this.lastDiscontinuity !== null && !firstOfRun) this.jumpPending = true;
      this.lastDiscontinuity = discontinuity;
    }
    const isNew =
      reportedMs !== this.lastReportMs || (!Number.isNaN(sampledAtMs) && sampledAtMs !== this.lastSampledAtMs);
    this.lastReportMs = reportedMs;
    this.lastSampledAtMs = sampledAtMs;

    if (firstOfRun) {
      this.lastNowMs = nowMs;
      const takenAt = Number.isNaN(sampledAtMs) || sampledAtMs <= this.heldAtMs ? nowMs : Math.min(sampledAtMs, nowMs);
      this.anchor(takenAt, reportedMs);
      this.displayedMs = this.targetAt(nowMs);
      return Math.trunc(this.displayedMs);
    }

    const dt = Math.max(0, nowMs - this.lastNowMs);
    this.lastNowMs = nowMs;
    this.advance(nowMs, dt);

    if (isNew) {
      const takenAt = Number.isNaN(sampledAtMs) ? nowMs : Math.min(sampledAtMs, nowMs);
      if (takenAt >= this.anchorAtMs || this.jumpPending) this.take(nowMs, takenAt, reportedMs);
    }
    return Math.trunc(this.displayedMs);
  }

  private take(nowMs: number, takenAt: number, reportedMs: number): void {
    if (this.jumpPending) {
      this.jumpPending = false;
      this.clearSuspect();
      this.anchor(takenAt, reportedMs);
      this.jumpTo(nowMs);
      return;
    }
    const elapsed = takenAt - this.anchorAtMs;
    if (Math.abs(reportedMs - (this.anchorMs + elapsed * this.rate)) <= this.tolerance(elapsed)) {
      this.clearSuspect();
      this.anchor(takenAt, reportedMs, true);
      return;
    }
    const sinceSuspect = takenAt - this.suspectAtMs;
    const agrees =
      !Number.isNaN(this.suspectAtMs) &&
      sinceSuspect >= 0 &&
      Math.abs(reportedMs - (this.suspectMs + sinceSuspect * this.rate)) <= this.tolerance(sinceSuspect);
    this.rejections++;
    if (agrees) {
      const firstAt = this.suspectAtMs;
      const first = this.suspectMs;
      this.clearSuspect();
      this.anchor(firstAt, first);
      this.anchor(takenAt, reportedMs, true);
    } else if (this.rejections > MAX_REJECTIONS) {
      this.clearSuspect();
      this.anchor(takenAt, reportedMs);
    } else {
      this.suspectAtMs = takenAt;
      this.suspectMs = reportedMs;
    }
  }

  private tolerance(elapsedMs: number): number {
    return OUTLIER_MS + Math.abs(elapsedMs) * (this.rateSettled ? RATE_SLACK : UNSETTLED_RATE_SLACK);
  }

  private anchor(atMs: number, positionMs: number, continues = false): void {
    this.anchorAtMs = atMs;
    this.anchorMs = positionMs;
    if (!continues) {
      this.historyAt = [];
      this.historyMs = [];
    }
    if (this.historyAt.length === HISTORY) {
      this.historyAt.shift();
      this.historyMs.shift();
    }
    this.historyAt.push(atMs);
    this.historyMs.push(this.anchorMs);
    this.learnRate();
  }

  private learnRate(): void {
    const newest = this.historyAt.length - 1;
    if (newest < 1) return;
    let oldest = 0;
    while (oldest < newest && this.historyAt[newest]! - this.historyAt[oldest]! > RATE_WINDOW_MS) oldest++;
    const span = this.historyAt[newest]! - this.historyAt[oldest]!;
    if (span >= MIN_RATE_SPAN_MS) {
      this.rate = clamp((this.historyMs[newest]! - this.historyMs[oldest]!) / span, MIN_RATE, MAX_RATE);
      this.rateSettled = true;
      return;
    }
    const pairSpan = this.historyAt[newest]! - this.historyAt[newest - 1]!;
    if (!this.rateSettled && pairSpan >= MIN_PAIR_SPAN_MS) {
      const measured = clamp((this.historyMs[newest]! - this.historyMs[newest - 1]!) / pairSpan, MIN_RATE, MAX_RATE);
      this.rate += (measured - this.rate) * PAIR_LEARNING;
    }
  }

  private clearSuspect(): void {
    this.suspectAtMs = Number.NaN;
    this.rejections = 0;
  }

  private advance(nowMs: number, dt: number): void {
    const target = this.targetAt(nowMs);
    const step = dt * this.rate;
    const error = target - (this.displayedMs + step);
    if (!Number.isNaN(this.glideStartMs)) {
      const progress = (nowMs - this.glideStartMs) / GLIDE_MS;
      if (progress >= 1) {
        this.displayedMs = target;
        this.glideStartMs = Number.NaN;
      } else {
        this.displayedMs = target + this.glideOffsetMs * (1 - smoothstep(progress));
      }
    } else if (error <= -LOST_MS || error >= LOST_MS) {
      this.displayedMs = target;
    } else if (error >= GLIDE_FROM_MS) {
      this.startGlide(nowMs - dt, this.displayedMs - (target - step));
      this.displayedMs = target + this.glideOffsetMs * (1 - smoothstep(dt / GLIDE_MS));
    } else {
      const closing = error * (dt / (dt + CORRECTION_MS));
      this.displayedMs += step + clamp(closing, -MAX_SLOW * step, MAX_SLEW * step);
    }
  }

  private jumpTo(nowMs: number): void {
    const offset = this.displayedMs - this.targetAt(nowMs);
    if (Math.abs(offset) > GLIDE_MAX_MS) {
      this.displayedMs = this.targetAt(nowMs);
      this.glideStartMs = Number.NaN;
    } else {
      this.startGlide(nowMs, offset);
    }
  }

  private startGlide(startMs: number, offsetMs: number): void {
    this.glideStartMs = startMs;
    this.glideOffsetMs = offsetMs;
  }

  /** Where the song is at [atMs]: the newest reading believed, carried forward. */
  private targetAt(atMs: number): number {
    return this.anchorMs + (atMs - this.anchorAtMs) * this.rate;
  }
}

const clamp = (value: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));

function smoothstep(fraction: number): number {
  const t = clamp(fraction, 0, 1);
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
}

const OUTLIER_MS = 250;
const RATE_SLACK = 0.2;
const UNSETTLED_RATE_SLACK = 0.75;
const MAX_REJECTIONS = 2;
const MIN_RATE_SPAN_MS = 900;
const RATE_WINDOW_MS = 4000;
const HISTORY = 16;
const MIN_PAIR_SPAN_MS = 300;
const PAIR_LEARNING = 0.5;
const MIN_RATE = 0.25;
const MAX_RATE = 4;
const CORRECTION_MS = 600;
const MAX_SLEW = 0.25;
const MAX_SLOW = 0.5;
const GLIDE_FROM_MS = 300;
const GLIDE_MS = 260;
const GLIDE_MAX_MS = 2000;
const LOST_MS = 3000;

import { BridgeCallError } from '@bitchord/shared/bridge';
import { getBridge } from '@/extension/bridge';

/**
 * The providers' one way out (LyricsHttp.kt): a GET that answers with the body
 * or null, never an exception. They're raced against each other, so the
 * deadline is short: a lyric that arrives after the second chorus is no use.
 *
 * - `direct`: from the page, for the hosts that allow cross-site requests;
 *   if the browser blocks it anyway (BetterLyrics allows some origins and
 *   not others), it's retried through the extension.
 * - `extension`: always through the extension's `lyrics.fetch`, for hosts
 *   that send no CORS headers or need headers a page can't set.
 */

/** Hosts the page can't reach itself: KuGou, Musixmatch, Genius and Apple's catalogue (for PaxSenix). */
export const LYRIC_EXTENSION_ORIGINS = [
  'https://mobileservice.kugou.com',
  'https://lyrics.kugou.com',
  'https://apic.musixmatch.com',
  'https://www.musixmatch.com',
  'https://genius.com',
  'https://music.apple.com',
  'https://amp-api.music.apple.com',
  'https://api.paxsenix.org',
  'https://lyrics-api.boidu.dev',
  'https://unison.boidu.dev',
];

const DIRECT_TIMEOUT_MS = 6000;
const EXTENSION_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;

/** Lyric hosts the extension was refused for: the panel offers to allow them. */
export const ungrantedOrigins = new Set<string>();
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
export function onUngrantedChange(listener: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(listener);
  return () => listeners.delete(listener);
}

const grantListeners = new Set<() => void>();
/** Called once a refused host has been allowed, so the lookups it failed can run again. */
export function onGranted(listener: () => void): () => void {
  grantListeners.add(listener);
  return () => grantListeners.delete(listener);
}

/**
 * Asks the extension which refused hosts it may reach now. The grant happens
 * on the extension's own page in another tab, so this runs when BitChord's
 * tab comes back.
 */
export async function recheckGrants(): Promise<void> {
  const bridge = getBridge();
  if (!bridge || !ungrantedOrigins.size) return;
  const { granted } = await bridge.call('lyrics.permissions', { origins: [...ungrantedOrigins] }).catch(() => ({ granted: [] }));
  if (!granted.length) return;
  granted.forEach((o) => ungrantedOrigins.delete(o));
  listeners.forEach((l) => l());
  grantListeners.forEach((l) => l());
}

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.addEventListener('focus', () => void recheckGrants());
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => document.visibilityState === 'visible' && void recheckGrants());
}

export interface GetOptions {
  route?: 'direct' | 'extension';
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Longer deadline for authenticated routes that look things up upstream (PaxSenix). */
  patient?: boolean;
}

async function viaExtension(url: string, headers: Record<string, string> | undefined): Promise<string | null> {
  const bridge = getBridge();
  if (!bridge) return null;
  try {
    const response = await bridge.call(
      'lyrics.fetch',
      { url, ...(headers && { headers }) },
      { timeoutMs: EXTENSION_TIMEOUT_MS },
    );
    if (response.status < 200 || response.status >= 300) return null;
    return response.bodyEncoding === 'base64' ? new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(atob(response.body), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0))) : response.body;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof BridgeCallError && error.code === 'permission') {
      const origin = new URL(url).origin;
      if (!ungrantedOrigins.has(origin)) {
        ungrantedOrigins.add(origin);
        listeners.forEach((l) => l());
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
}

export async function lyricsGet(url: string, { route = 'direct', headers, patient }: GetOptions = {}): Promise<string | null> {
  if (route === 'extension') return viaExtension(url, headers);
  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      headers: { Accept: 'application/json, text/plain, */*', ...headers },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(patient ? EXTENSION_TIMEOUT_MS : DIRECT_TIMEOUT_MS),
      referrerPolicy: 'no-referrer',
    });
    return response.ok ? await response.text() : null;
  } catch (error) {
    // A CORS refusal looks like a network error from here; the extension isn't bound by it.
    if (error instanceof TypeError) return viaExtension(url, headers);
    return null;
  }
}

/** A URL with query parameters, skipping empty ones. */
export function urlWith(base: string, params: Record<string, string | number | null | undefined>): string {
  const url = new URL(base);
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== '') url.searchParams.set(key, String(value));
  }
  return url.toString();
}

File: web/app/src/lyrics/model.ts

/**
 * The lyric model, as shared/…/data/lyrics/LyricLine.kt has it: the data
 * only. Drawing is am-lyrics' job (prompt §10.2); these types exist so every
 * provider's answer can be compared, cleaned up and written out as TTML.
 */

/** One separately timed piece of a word: characters [startChar, endChar) sung from startMs to endMs. */
export interface LyricSyllable {
  startMs: number;
  endMs: number;
  startChar: number;
  endChar: number;
}

/** One word of a line; Apple splits long ones into syllables, which keep their own timing. */
export interface LyricWord {
  startMs: number;
  endMs: number;
  text: string;
  /** Empty for a word nobody split, which is most of them. */
  syllables: LyricSyllable[];
}

export type LyricAlignment = 'start' | 'end';

/** One line. A blank text is an instrumental stretch; words only where the provider timed them. */
export interface LyricLine {
  timeMs: number;
  text: string;
  words: LyricWord[];
  /** The line's own end, where a line-synced provider states one. */
  sungUntilMs: number | null;
  /** The answering vocal, drawn under the lead; never nested. */
  background: LyricLine | null;
  alignment: LyricAlignment;
}

export function line(timeMs: number, text: string, extra: Partial<LyricLine> = {}): LyricLine {
  return { timeMs, text, words: [], sungUntilMs: null, background: null, alignment: 'start', ...extra };
}

export const isGap = (l: LyricLine) => l.text.length === 0;
export const isWordSynced = (l: LyricLine) => l.words.length > 0;
/** Whether anything said when the singing stops (LyricLine.hasKnownEnd). */
export const hasKnownEnd = (l: LyricLine) => l.words.length > 0 || l.sungUntilMs !== null;

/** When the last word finishes, or the stated end, or the start; the answering vocal counts. */
export function endMs(l: LyricLine): number {
  const lead = l.words.at(-1)?.endMs ?? l.sungUntilMs ?? l.timeMs;
  return Math.max(lead, l.background ? endMs(l.background) : lead);
}

/** LyricSyllable.normalized: in order, end to end, covering the word; empty when there's nothing to split. */
export function normalizedSyllables(parts: LyricSyllable[], length: number): LyricSyllable[] {
  const usable = parts.filter((p) => p.endChar > p.startChar && p.startChar < length).sort((a, b) => a.startChar - b.startChar);
  if (usable.length < 2) return [];
  return usable.map((part, index) => ({
    startMs: part.startMs,
    endMs: Math.max(part.startMs, part.endMs),
    startChar: index === 0 ? 0 : part.startChar,
    endChar: usable[index + 1]?.startChar ?? length,
  }));
}

// ---- SyllableRuns.kt --------------------------------------------------------------------

/** One stamped run as a provider wrote it, spacing untouched: a word, or one syllable of one. */
export interface TimedRun {
  startMs: number;
  endMs: number;
  raw: string;
}

const UNSPACED = /[㐀-鿿぀-ヿ　-〿＀-￯฀-๿]/;
const isWhitespace = (c: string | undefined) => c !== undefined && /\s/.test(c);

/**
 * Glues runs into words. A run that neither ends in whitespace nor is followed
 * by one starting with it is the front of a word that carries on. Han, kana
 * and Thai never glue, and a line with no whitespace anywhere isn't stating
 * word boundaries (unless [spacingIsExplicit]).
 */
export function wordsFromRuns(runs: TimedRun[], spacingIsExplicit = false): LyricWord[] {
  const glue = spacingIsExplicit || runs.some((run) => /\s/.test(run.raw));
  const words: LyricWord[] = [];
  let current = '';
  let parts: LyricSyllable[] = [];
  let start = 0;
  let end = 0;
  const flush = () => {
    if (current) words.push({ startMs: start, endMs: Math.max(start, end), text: current, syllables: normalizedSyllables(parts, current.length) });
    current = '';
    parts = [];
  };
  for (const run of runs) {
    const content = run.raw.trim();
    if (!content) {
      flush();
      continue;
    }
    const joins =
      glue && current.length > 0 && !isWhitespace(run.raw[0]) && !UNSPACED.test(current.at(-1)!) && !UNSPACED.test(content[0]!);
    if (!joins) flush();
    if (!current) {
      start = run.startMs;
      end = run.startMs;
    }
    const from = current.length;
    current += content;
    const runEnd = Math.max(run.startMs, run.endMs);
    parts.push({ startMs: run.startMs, endMs: runEnd, startChar: from, endChar: current.length });
    end = Math.max(end, runEnd);
    if (!glue || isWhitespace(run.raw.at(-1))) flush();
  }
  flush();
  return words;
}

// ---- LyricGaps.kt ---------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Shorter instrumental breaks aren't worth interrupting the line for. */
export const MIN_GAP_MS = 4000;

/** Blank lines for the instrumental stretches, only where a line says when its singing stopped. */
export function withInstrumentalGaps(lines: LyricLine[]): LyricLine[] {
  if (!lines.length) return lines;
  const out: LyricLine[] = [];
  if (lines[0]!.timeMs >= MIN_GAP_MS) out.push(line(0, ''));
  lines.forEach((l, index) => {
    out.push(l);
    const next = lines[index + 1];
    if (!next || !hasKnownEnd(l)) return;
    const end = endMs(l);
    if (next.timeMs - end >= MIN_GAP_MS && end > l.timeMs) out.push(line(end, ''));
  });
  return out;
}

// ---- BackgroundVocals.kt ----------------------------------------------------------------

function bracketStart(text: string): number | null {
  if (!text.endsWith(')')) return null;
  let depth = 0;
  for (let index = text.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
    if (text[index] === ')') depth++;
    else if (text[index] === '(') {
      depth--;
      if (depth === 0) return index > 0 ? index : null;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function wordStartingAt(words: LyricWord[], offset: number): number | null {
  let at = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < words.length; index++) {
    if (at === offset) return index;
    if (at > offset) return null;
    at += words[index]!.text.length + 1;
  }
  return null;
}

/** A trailing "(answer)" bracket becomes the line's background vocal, with its own timing. */
export function withBackgroundVocals(lines: LyricLine[]): LyricLine[] {
  return lines.map((l) => {
    if (l.background || isGap(l)) return l;
    const open = bracketStart(l.text);
    if (open === null) return l;
    const lead = l.text.slice(0, open).trimEnd();
    const backing = l.text.slice(open).trim();
    if (!lead || !/[\p{L}\p{N}]/u.test(backing)) return l;
    if (!l.words.length) return { ...l, text: lead, background: line(l.timeMs, backing, { sungUntilMs: l.sungUntilMs }) };
    const split = wordStartingAt(l.words, open);
    if (!split || split <= 0) return l;
    const backingWords = l.words.slice(split);
    return {
      ...l,
      text: lead,
      words: l.words.slice(0, split),
      background: line(backingWords[0]!.startMs, backing, { words: backingWords }),
    };
  });
}

// ---- LyricAlignments.kt ---------------------------------------------------------------------

const MOSTLY_RIGHT = 0.85;

/** Which side each line is sung from, alternating as the voice changes; group lines stay left. */
export function lineAlignments(singers: (string | null | undefined)[], types: Record<string, string>): LyricAlignment[] {
  let left = true;
  let lastVoice: string | null = null;
  let rightward = 0;
  let placed = 0;
  const sides = singers.map((singer): LyricAlignment => {
    if (!singer) return 'start';
    const type = types[singer] ?? (singer === 'v1000' ? 'group' : singer === 'v2000' ? 'other' : 'person');
    placed += 1;
    if (type === 'group') return 'start';
    if (lastVoice === null) left = type !== 'other';
    else if (singer !== lastVoice) left = !left;
    lastVoice = singer;
    if (!left) rightward += 1;
    return left ? 'start' : 'end';
  });
  if (placed === 0 || rightward / placed < MOSTLY_RIGHT) return sides;
  return sides.map((s) => (s === 'start' ? 'end' : 'start'));
}

/** Genius's "[Chorus]" markers, rather than words to sing. */
export function isSectionHeader(text: string): boolean {
  const t = text.trim();
  return t.startsWith('[') && t.endsWith(']') && t.length >= 3 && t.length <= 60;
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { withBackgroundVocals } from './model';
import { decodeEntities, parseEnhancedLrc, parseKaraoke, parseLrc, parseProvider, parseTtml } from './parse';
import { writeTtml } from './ttml';

const APPLE = `<tt xmlns="http://www.w3.org/ns/ttml" xmlns:ttm="http://www.w3.org/ns/ttml#metadata">
<head><metadata><ttm:agent type="person" xml:id="v1"/><ttm:agent type="person" xml:id="v2"/></metadata></head>
<body><div>
<p begin="27.395" end="29.0" ttm:agent="v1"><span begin="27.395" end="27.549">I</span> <span begin="27.549" end="27.740">been</span> <span begin="27.8" end="28.0">e</span><span begin="28.0" end="28.6">nough</span><span ttm:role="x-bg"><span begin="28.6" end="29.0">(ooh)</span></span></p>
<p begin="31.0" end="32.0" ttm:agent="v2"><span begin="31.0" end="32.0">Hey</span></p>
</div></body></tt>`;

describe('TTML (TtmlLyrics)', () => {
  it('glues syllables into words and keeps their timings', () => {
    const lines = parseTtml(APPLE).filter((l) => l.text);
    expect(lines[0]!.text).toBe('I been enough');
    const enough = lines[0]!.words[2]!;
    expect(enough).toMatchObject({ text: 'enough', startMs: 27800, endMs: 28600 });
    expect(enough.syllables.map((s) => [s.startChar, s.endChar])).toEqual([
      [0, 1],
      [1, 6],
    ]);
  });
  it('keeps the answering vocal apart', () => {
    const [first] = parseTtml(APPLE).filter((l) => l.text);
    expect(first!.background?.text).toBe('(ooh)');
    expect(first!.words.map((w) => w.text)).not.toContain('(ooh)');
  });
  it('puts a second voice on the other side', () => {
    expect(parseTtml(APPLE).filter((l) => l.text).map((l) => l.alignment)).toEqual(['start', 'end']);
  });
  it('marks a long intro as a gap', () => {
    expect(parseTtml(APPLE)[0]).toMatchObject({ timeMs: 0, text: '' });
  });
});

describe('LRC', () => {
  it('reads enhanced (A2) LRC word stamps', () => {
    const lines = parseEnhancedLrc('[00:27.39]<00:27.39>I <00:27.54>been <00:27.74>tryna\n[00:30.00]<00:30.00>call');
    expect(lines.map((l) => l.text)).toEqual(['', 'I been tryna', 'call']);
    expect(lines[1]!.words[2]).toMatchObject({ startMs: 27740, endMs: 30000 });
  });
  it('reads plain LRC, dropping metadata tags and short breaks', () => {
    const lines = parseLrc('[ar:Someone]\n[00:01.00]one\n[00:02.00]\n[00:03.50]two');
    expect(lines.map((l) => l.text)).toEqual(['one', 'two']);
  });
  it('decodes HTML entities', () => {
    expect(decodeEntities('don&#x27;t &amp; won&#39;t')).toBe("don't & won't");
  });
});

describe('karaoke (QRC/YRC)', () => {
  it('reads millisecond word ranges', () => {
    const lines = parseKaraoke('[1000,2000](1000,500,0)Hel(1500,500,0)lo (2000,1000,0)there');
    expect(lines[0]).toMatchObject({ timeMs: 1000, text: 'Hello there', sungUntilMs: 3000 });
  });
});

  it('splits a trailing bracket off a line-synced line', () => {
    const [l] = withBackgroundVocals(parseLrc("[00:01.00]I'm foolishly patient (Foolishly patient)"));
    expect(l).toMatchObject({ text: "I'm foolishly patient", background: { text: '(Foolishly patient)' } });
  });
});

describe('TTML writer', () => {
  it('round-trips word timings, syllables, background and sides', () => {
    const original = parseTtml(APPLE).filter((l) => l.text);
    const again = parseTtml(writeTtml(original)).filter((l) => l.text);
    expect(again.map((l) => l.text)).toEqual(original.map((l) => l.text));
    expect(again[0]!.words[2]!.syllables).toEqual(original[0]!.words[2]!.syllables);
    expect(again[0]!.background?.text).toBe('(ooh)');
    expect(again.map((l) => l.alignment)).toEqual(['start', 'end']);
  });
  it('writes untimed lyrics without times', () => {
    const ttml = writeTtml(parseProvider('first line\nsecond line')!.lines);
    expect(ttml).toContain('itunes:timing="None"');
    expect(ttml).not.toContain('begin=');
  });
});

import {
  line,
  lineAlignments,
  MIN_GAP_MS,
  normalizedSyllables,
  withInstrumentalGaps,
  wordsFromRuns,
  type LyricLine,
  type LyricSyllable,
  type LyricWord,
  type TimedRun,
} from './model';

/**
 * Every wire format the providers use, read into the lyric model: ports of
 * TtmlLyrics.kt, EnhancedLrc.kt, LrcLib.parseLrc, KaraokeLrc and
 * ProviderLyrics.kt.
 */

// ---- EnhancedLrc.decodeEntities -------------------------------------------------------------

/** SimpMusic and friends serve HTML-escaped text; "&#x27;" would otherwise be sung literally. */
export function decodeEntities(text: string): string {
  if (!text.includes('&')) return text;
  return text
    .replace(/&#x([0-9a-fA-F]+);/g, (_, hex: string) => String.fromCodePoint(Number.parseInt(hex, 16)))
    .replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (_, dec: string) => String.fromCodePoint(Number(dec)))
    .replace(/&apos;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ')
    .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
    .replace(/&amp;/g, '&');
}

// ---- TTML (TtmlLyrics.kt) ---------------------------------------------------------------------

const SKIPPED_ROLES = new Set(['x-translation', 'x-roman']);
const BACKGROUND_ROLE = 'x-bg';

/** TTML clock values: 27.395, 1:05.20, 1:02:03.4, or a number with s/ms. */
export function ttmlTime(value: string | null | undefined): number | null {
  const raw = value?.trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  if (raw.endsWith('ms')) {
    const ms = Number(raw.slice(0, -2));
    return Number.isFinite(ms) ? Math.trunc(ms) : null;
  }
  const parts = raw.replace(/s$/, '').split(':').map(Number);
  if (parts.some((p) => !Number.isFinite(p)) || parts.length > 3) return null;
  const seconds = parts.reduce((total, part) => total * 60 + part, 0);
  return Math.trunc(seconds * 1000);
}

/** An attribute named with a prefix, whichever way the DOM files it. */
function qualified(element: Element, name: string): string {
  const direct = element.getAttribute(name);
  if (direct) return direct;
  const local = name.split(':')[1] ?? name;
  for (const attribute of Array.from(element.attributes)) {
    if (attribute.name === name || attribute.name === local || attribute.localName === local) return attribute.value;
  }
  return '';
}

type Piece = { kind: 'text'; text: string } | { kind: 'timed'; text: string; start: number; end: number };

function hasTimedChild(element: Element): boolean {
  return Array.from(element.children).some((child) => child.getAttribute('begin') || hasTimedChild(child));
}

function collect(node: Node, out: Piece[], backing: Piece[]): void {
  for (const child of Array.from(node.childNodes)) {
    if (child.nodeType === 1) {
      const element = child as Element;
      const role = qualified(element, 'ttm:role');
      if (SKIPPED_ROLES.has(role)) continue;
      const sink = role === BACKGROUND_ROLE ? backing : out;
      const begin = ttmlTime(element.getAttribute('begin'));
      const end = ttmlTime(element.getAttribute('end'));
      if (begin !== null && end !== null && !hasTimedChild(element)) {
        sink.push({ kind: 'timed', text: element.textContent ?? '', start: begin, end });
      } else {
        collect(element, sink, backing);
      }
    } else if (child.nodeType === 3) {
      const text = child.textContent ?? '';
      if (text) out.push({ kind: 'text', text });
    }
  }
}

/** Glues syllables into words: whitespace, not the span boundary, ends a word. */
function mergeIntoWords(pieces: Piece[]): LyricWord[] {
  const words: LyricWord[] = [];
  let current = '';
  let syllables: LyricSyllable[] = [];
  let start = 0;
  let end = 0;
  let timed = false;
  const flush = () => {
    const text = current.trim();
    current = '';
    if (text && timed) words.push({ startMs: start, endMs: end, text, syllables: normalizedSyllables(syllables, text.length) });
    syllables = [];
    timed = false;
  };
  for (const piece of pieces) {
    if (piece.kind === 'text') {
      if (!piece.text.trim()) flush();
      else if (timed) current += piece.text;
      continue;
    }
    if (!piece.text.trim()) continue;
    if (/^\s/.test(piece.text)) flush();
    if (!current) start = piece.start;
    const from = current.length;
    current += piece.text.trim();
    syllables.push({ startMs: piece.start, endMs: piece.end, startChar: from, endChar: current.length });
    end = piece.end;
    timed = true;
    if (/\s$/.test(piece.text)) flush();
  }
  flush();
  return words;
}

function lineFrom(paragraph: Element): LyricLine | null {
  const pieces: Piece[] = [];
  const backingPieces: Piece[] = [];
  collect(paragraph, pieces, backingPieces);
  const words = mergeIntoWords(pieces);
  const backingWords = mergeIntoWords(backingPieces);
  const backing = backingWords.length
    ? line(backingWords[0]!.startMs, backingWords.map((w) => w.text).join(' '), { words: backingWords })
    : null;
  if (!words.length) {
    const text = paragraph.textContent?.trim() ?? '';
    const begin = ttmlTime(paragraph.getAttribute('begin'));
    if (begin === null || !text) return null;
    const end = ttmlTime(paragraph.getAttribute('end'));
    return line(begin, text, { sungUntilMs: end !== null && end > begin ? end : null });
  }
  const begin = ttmlTime(paragraph.getAttribute('begin')) ?? words[0]!.startMs;
  return line(Math.min(begin, words[0]!.startMs), words.map((w) => w.text).join(' '), { words, background: backing });
}

export function parseTtml(ttml: string): LyricLine[] {
  try {
    const document = new DOMParser().parseFromString(ttml, 'text/xml');
    if (document.getElementsByTagName('parsererror').length) return [];
    const types: Record<string, string> = {};
    const agents = document.getElementsByTagName('ttm:agent').length
      ? document.getElementsByTagName('ttm:agent')
      : document.getElementsByTagName('agent');
    for (const agent of Array.from(agents)) {
      const id = qualified(agent, 'xml:id');
      const type = agent.getAttribute('type');
      if (id && type) types[id] = type;
    }
    const sung: { line: LyricLine; agent: string | null }[] = [];
    for (const paragraph of Array.from(document.getElementsByTagName('p'))) {
      const l = lineFrom(paragraph);
      if (l) sung.push({ line: l, agent: qualified(paragraph, 'ttm:agent') || null });
    }
    sung.sort((a, b) => a.line.timeMs - b.line.timeMs);
    const sides = lineAlignments(
      sung.map((s) => s.agent),
      types,
    );
    return withInstrumentalGaps(sung.map((s, i) => ({ ...s.line, alignment: sides[i]! })));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

// ---- Enhanced (A2) LRC (EnhancedLrc.kt) -----------------------------------------------------

const A2_LINE = /^\[(\d{1,3}):(\d{2})[.:](\d{2,3})\](.*)$/;
const A2_WORD = /<(\d{1,3}):(\d{2})[.:](\d{2,3})>([^<]*)/g;
const TAIL_MS = 800;

function stamp(minutes: string, seconds: string, fraction: string): number {
  const fractionMs = fraction.length === 3 ? Number(fraction) : Number(fraction) * 10;
  return Number(minutes) * 60_000 + Number(seconds) * 1000 + fractionMs;
}

/** Empty when the LRC carries no word stamps, so the caller can fall back to plain LRC. */
export function parseEnhancedLrc(lrc: string): LyricLine[] {
  const rows = lrc
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((l) => A2_LINE.exec(l.trim()))
    .filter((m): m is RegExpExecArray => !!m)
    .map((m) => ({ timeMs: stamp(m[1]!, m[2]!, m[3]!), words: [...m[4]!.matchAll(A2_WORD)], plain: m[4]!.trim() }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.timeMs - b.timeMs);
  if (!rows.some((r) => r.words.length)) return [];
  const lines: LyricLine[] = [];
  rows.forEach((row, index) => {
    if (!row.words.length) {
      const text = decodeEntities(row.plain);
      if (text) lines.push(line(row.timeMs, text));
      return;
    }
    const last = row.words.at(-1)!;
    const lineEnd = rows[index + 1]?.timeMs ?? stamp(last[1]!, last[2]!, last[3]!) + TAIL_MS;
    const runs: TimedRun[] = row.words.map((m, i) => {
      const next = row.words[i + 1];
      return {
        startMs: stamp(m[1]!, m[2]!, m[3]!),
        endMs: next ? stamp(next[1]!, next[2]!, next[3]!) : lineEnd,
        raw: decodeEntities(m[4]!),
      };
    });
    const words = wordsFromRuns(runs);
    if (!words.length) return;
    lines.push(line(Math.min(row.timeMs, words[0]!.startMs), words.map((w) => w.text).join(' '), { words }));
  });
  return withInstrumentalGaps(lines);
}

// ---- Plain LRC (LrcLib.parseLrc) --------------------------------------------------------------

const LRC_STAMP = /\[(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})[.:](\d{2,3})\]/;
const WORD_STAMP = /<(\d{1,3}):(\d{2})[.:](\d{2,3})>/g;
const ALIGNMENT_MARKER = '<R>';

export function parseLrc(lrc: string): LyricLine[] {
  const all: LyricLine[] = [];
  for (const raw of lrc.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const match = LRC_STAMP.exec(raw);
    if (!match) continue;
    let body = raw.slice((match.index ?? 0) + match[0].length);
    let alignment: LyricLine['alignment'] = 'start';
    if (body.startsWith(ALIGNMENT_MARKER)) {
      body = body.slice(ALIGNMENT_MARKER.length);
      alignment = 'end';
    }
    const marks = [...body.matchAll(WORD_STAMP)];
    const runs: TimedRun[] = marks.map((mark, i) => {
      const until = marks[i + 1]?.index ?? body.length;
      const startMs = stamp(mark[1]!, mark[2]!, mark[3]!);
      const next = marks[i + 1];
      return {
        startMs,
        endMs: next ? stamp(next[1]!, next[2]!, next[3]!) : startMs,
        raw: body.slice((mark.index ?? 0) + mark[0].length, until),
      };
    });
    all.push(
      line(stamp(match[1]!, match[2]!, match[3]!), body.replace(WORD_STAMP, '').trim(), {
        words: marks.length ? wordsFromRuns(runs) : [],
        alignment,
      }),
    );
  }
  all.sort((a, b) => a.timeMs - b.timeMs);
  const kept = all.filter((l, index) => {
    if (l.text) return true;
    const next = all[index + 1];
    return !next || next.timeMs - l.timeMs >= MIN_GAP_MS;
  });
  const first = kept[0];
  return first && first.text && first.timeMs >= MIN_GAP_MS ? [line(0, ''), ...kept] : kept;
}

// ---- QQ/QRC and NetEase YRC (KaraokeLrc) ------------------------------------------------------

const KARAOKE_LINE = /^\[(\d{1,8}),(\d{1,8})\](.*)$/;
const PREFIX_WORD = /\((\d{1,8}),(\d{1,8})(?:,\d{1,8})?\)([^()]*)/g;
const SUFFIX_WORD = /([^()]*)\((\d{1,8}),(\d{1,8})(?:,\d{1,8})?\)/g;
const KARAOKE_TIME = /\(\d{1,8},\d{1,8}(?:,\d{1,8})?\)/g;
const LYRIC_CONTENT = /LyricContent\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"/i;

function karaokeContent(raw: string): string {
  const inner = LYRIC_CONTENT.exec(raw)?.[1];
  return inner
    ? inner.replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&apos;/g, "'").replace(/&lt;/g, '<').replace(/&gt;/g, '>').replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    : raw;
}

export function looksLikeKaraoke(raw: string): boolean {
  return karaokeContent(raw)
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .some((l) => {
      const body = KARAOKE_LINE.exec(l.trim())?.[3];
      return !!body && (new RegExp(PREFIX_WORD.source).test(body) || new RegExp(SUFFIX_WORD.source).test(body));
    });
}

export function parseKaraoke(raw: string): LyricLine[] {
  const rows: LyricLine[] = [];
  for (const source of karaokeContent(raw).split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const match = KARAOKE_LINE.exec(source.trim());
    if (!match) continue;
    const lineStart = Number(match[1]);
    const lineDuration = Number(match[2]);
    const body = match[3]!;
    const run = (text: string, start: string, duration: string): TimedRun => ({
      startMs: Number(start),
      endMs: Number(start) + Number(duration),
      raw: decodeEntities(text),
    });
    const prefixed = wordsFromRuns([...body.matchAll(PREFIX_WORD)].map((m) => run(m[3]!, m[1]!, m[2]!)));
    const suffixed = wordsFromRuns([...body.matchAll(SUFFIX_WORD)].map((m) => run(m[1]!, m[2]!, m[3]!)));
    const length = (words: LyricWord[]) => words.reduce((n, w) => n + w.text.length, 0);
    const words = length(prefixed) >= length(suffixed) ? prefixed : suffixed;
    if (!words.length) continue;
    const text = decodeEntities(body.replace(KARAOKE_TIME, '')).trim();
    if (!text) continue;
    rows.push(
      line(Math.min(lineStart, words[0]!.startMs), text, {
        words,
        sungUntilMs: lineDuration > 0 ? lineStart + lineDuration : null,
      }),
    );
  }
  return withInstrumentalGaps(rows.sort((a, b) => a.timeMs - b.timeMs));
}

// ---- Whatever a provider sent (ProviderLyrics.kt) ------------------------------------------------

const CONTENT_KEYS = [
  'ttml', 'ttmlContent', 'lyrics', 'lrc', 'content', 'text', 'plainLyrics', 'syncedLyrics',
  'line', 'lines', 'lyric', 'data', 'result', 'response',
];

function extract(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const text = value.trim();
    try {
      const nested: unknown = JSON.parse(text);
      if (nested && typeof nested === 'object') return extract(nested);
    } catch {
      // Not JSON: the text itself.
    }
    return text;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(extract).filter(Boolean).join('\n') || null;
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    const object = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (object.isError === true || object.ok === false || (object.error && object.error !== false && object.error !== '')) return null;
    for (const key of CONTENT_KEYS) {
      const found = key in object ? extract(object[key]) : null;
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return extract(object.metadata) ?? extract(object.words);
  }
  return null;
}

/** Providers sometimes wrap the lyric string in one or two JSON envelopes. */
export function unwrap(raw: string): string | null {
  let value = raw.replace(/﻿/g, '').trim();
  if (value.startsWith('```')) {
    const lines = value.split('\n').slice(1);
    if (lines.at(-1)?.trim() === '```') lines.pop();
    value = lines.join('\n').trim();
  }
  if (!value) return null;
  try {
    return extract(JSON.parse(value))?.trim() || null;
  } catch {
    return value;
  }
}

function unescapeTtml(value: string): string {
  return /&lt;tt/i.test(value)
    ? value.replace(/&lt;/g, '<').replace(/&gt;/g, '>').replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&#39;|&apos;/g, "'").replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    : value;
}

function plain(content: string): LyricLine[] {
  if (/\b(?:lyrics? (?:not found|unavailable)|error)\b/i.test(content)) return [];
  return content
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((l) => l.trim())
    .filter((l) => l && !/^\[[A-Za-z]+:.*\]$/.test(l))
    .map((l) => line(0, l));
}

export interface Parsed {
  lines: LyricLine[];
  /** The original document, when it was TTML: am-lyrics renders it as is. */
  ttml: string | null;
}

/** Turns any provider's body into lines (and keeps a TTML original). */
export function parseProvider(raw: string): Parsed | null {
  const unwrapped = unwrap(raw);
  if (!unwrapped) return null;
  const content = unescapeTtml(unwrapped);
  let lines: LyricLine[];
  let ttml: string | null = null;
  if (/<tt(?:\s|>)/i.test(content) || /http:\/\/www\.w3\.org\/ns\/ttml/i.test(content)) {
    lines = parseTtml(content);
    ttml = content;
  } else if (looksLikeKaraoke(content)) lines = parseKaraoke(content);
  else if (content.trimStart().startsWith('<')) lines = [];
  else {
    lines = parseEnhancedLrc(content);
    if (!lines.length) lines = parseLrc(content);
    if (!lines.length) lines = plain(content);
  }
  return lines.some((l) => l.text.trim()) ? { lines, ttml } : null;
}

export { plain as plainLines };

File: web/app/src/lyrics/providers.ts
