import { line, lineAlignments, withInstrumentalGaps, wordsFromRuns, type LyricLine, type TimedRun } from './model';
import { decodeEntities, parseEnhancedLrc, parseLrc, parseProvider, parseTtml, plainLines, type Parsed } from './parse';
import { lyricsGet, urlWith } from './http';
import { appleWebToken } from '@/data/apple/webToken';

/**
 * Every provider, ported from shared/…/data/lyrics/<Name>.kt. Each takes the
 * cleaned query and answers with parsed lines (plus the original TTML where
 * the host sent Apple's), or null for a miss. None of them throws.
 */

export interface LyricsQuery {
  videoId: string;
  /** Already cleaned for search (sources.forLyricsSearch). */
  title: string;
  artist: string;
  durationMs: number;
  album: string | null;
  /** The recording, when known (BiniLyrics found it, or a previous lookup did). */
  isrc: string | null;
}

/** Fetches a document once per lookup, however many providers want it (LyricsRepository.SharedDocuments). */
export type SharedGet = (url: string) => Promise<string | null>;

const fromTtml = (ttml: string | null): Parsed | null => {
  if (!ttml) return null;
  const lines = parseTtml(ttml);
  return lines.length ? { lines, ttml } : null;
};
const fromLines = (lines: LyricLine[] | null | undefined): Parsed | null =>
  lines?.some((l) => l.text.trim()) ? { lines, ttml: null } : null;
const seconds = (ms: number) => (ms > 0 ? Math.floor(ms / 1000) : null);

function json<T>(body: string | null): T | null {
  if (!body) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(body) as T;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ---- lrc.red (LrcRed.kt) -----------------------------------------------------------------

const LRC_RED = 'https://lrc.red/';
const ISRC = /^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{3}\d{7}$/;

export function lrcRedDocument(isrc: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const code = isrc?.trim().toUpperCase();
  return code && ISRC.test(code) ? `${LRC_RED}s/${code}.ttml` : null;
}

interface LrcRedHit {
  isrc?: string;
  title?: string;
  artist?: string;
  duration?: number;
}

const VERSION_WORDS = new Set([
  'live', 'remix', 'remixed', 'mix', 'acoustic', 'unplugged', 'instrumental', 'karaoke', 'cappella', 'acapella',
  'demo', 'edit', 'version', 'cover', 'sped', 'slowed', 'reverb', 'nightcore', 'lofi', 'orchestral', 'extended',
]);
const BRACKETED = /[([][^)\]]*[)\]]/g;
const ARTIST_SEPARATORS = /\s*(?:,|&|;|\/|\s+and\s+|\s+x\s+|\s+with\s+|\s+feat\.?\s+|\s+ft\.?\s+)\s*/i;

/** Lower case, accents off ("ROSÉ" is "rose"), letters and digits only. */
const normalized = (value: string) =>
  value
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/\p{Mn}+/gu, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
const coreOf = (title: string) => normalized(title.replace(BRACKETED, ' ').split(' - ')[0]!) || normalized(title);
const versionOf = (title: string) =>
  new Set(
    normalized(`${(title.match(BRACKETED) ?? []).join(' ')} ${title.includes(' - ') ? title.slice(title.indexOf(' - ') + 3) : ''}`)
      .split(' ')
      .filter((w) => VERSION_WORDS.has(w)),
  );
const artistsOf = (artist: string) => new Set(artist.split(ARTIST_SEPARATORS).map(normalized).filter(Boolean));
const sameSet = (a: Set<string>, b: Set<string>) => a.size === b.size && [...a].every((x) => b.has(x));

/** The hit that is this recording, or null: every test a requirement, the closest length wins. */
export function bestLrcRedHit(hits: LrcRedHit[], title: string, artist: string, durationMs: number): LrcRedHit | null {
  const wantedTitle = coreOf(title);
  const wantedVersion = versionOf(title);
  const wantedArtists = artistsOf(artist);
  const secs = durationMs / 1000;
  const distance = (hit: LrcRedHit) => (durationMs > 0 && hit.duration != null ? Math.abs(hit.duration - secs) : 0);
  const passing = hits.filter(
    (hit) =>
      !!hit.title &&
      !!lrcRedDocument(hit.isrc) &&
      coreOf(hit.title) === wantedTitle &&
      sameSet(versionOf(hit.title), wantedVersion) &&
      (!wantedArtists.size || [...artistsOf(hit.artist ?? '')].some((a) => wantedArtists.has(a))) &&
      distance(hit) <= 3,
  );
  return passing.sort((a, b) => distance(a) - distance(b))[0] ?? null;
}

export async function lrcRed(q: LyricsQuery, get: SharedGet): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  const known = lrcRedDocument(q.isrc);
  if (known) {
    const found = fromTtml(await get(known));
    if (found) return found;
  }
  const body = json<{ hits?: LrcRedHit[] }>(await lyricsGet(urlWith(`${LRC_RED}search.json`, { q: `${q.title} ${q.artist}`.trim() })));
  const hit = bestLrcRedHit(body?.hits ?? [], q.title, q.artist, q.durationMs);
  const url = lrcRedDocument(hit?.isrc);
  return url && url !== known ? fromTtml(await get(url)) : null;
}

// ---- BiniLyrics (BiniLyrics.kt) ------------------------------------------------------------

export interface BiniHit {
  isrc?: string;
  lyricsUrl?: string;
}

/** Which recording this is, without fetching its words: the ISRC every other source can use. */
export async function biniIdentify(q: LyricsQuery): Promise<BiniHit | null> {
  const url = q.isrc
    ? urlWith('https://lyrics-api.binimum.org/', { isrc: q.isrc })
    : urlWith('https://lyrics-api.binimum.org/', { track: q.title, artist: q.artist, album: q.album, duration: seconds(q.durationMs) });
  return json<{ results?: BiniHit[] }>(await lyricsGet(url))?.results?.[0] ?? null;
}

export async function bini(q: LyricsQuery, get: SharedGet, hit: BiniHit | null): Promise<(Parsed & { isrc: string | null }) | null> {
  const found = hit ?? (await biniIdentify(q));
  if (!found?.lyricsUrl) return null;
  const parsed = fromTtml(await get(found.lyricsUrl));
  return parsed ? { ...parsed, isrc: found.isrc || null } : null;
}

// ---- BetterLyrics (BetterLyrics.kt) -----------------------------------------------------------

async function betterLyricsAt(endpoint: string, q: LyricsQuery): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  const body = await lyricsGet(urlWith(endpoint, { s: q.title, a: q.artist, d: seconds(q.durationMs), al: q.album }));
  return body ? parseProvider(body) : null;
}
export const betterLyrics = (q: LyricsQuery) => betterLyricsAt('https://lyrics-api.boidu.dev/getLyrics', q);
export const betterLyricsPortato = (q: LyricsQuery) => betterLyricsAt('https://lyrics-api.boidu.dev/qq/getLyrics', q);

// ---- Unison (Unison.kt) -----------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function unison(q: LyricsQuery): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  const body = json<{ success?: boolean; data?: { lyrics?: string; format?: string; syncType?: string } }>(
    await lyricsGet(urlWith('https://unison.boidu.dev/lyrics', { song: q.title, artist: q.artist, album: q.album, duration: seconds(q.durationMs) })),
  );
  const data = body?.success ? body.data : null;
  const text = data?.lyrics?.trim();
  if (!text) return null;
  if (data!.format?.toLowerCase() === 'ttml') return fromTtml(text);
  if (data!.syncType?.toLowerCase() === 'plain') return fromLines(plainLines(text));
  const enhanced = parseEnhancedLrc(text);
  return fromLines(enhanced.length ? enhanced : parseLrc(text));
}

// ---- PaxSenix (PaxSenix.kt) ---------------------------------------------------------------------

interface Candidate {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  artist: string;
  durationMs: number;
}

const ID_KEYS = ['id', 'trackId', 'track_id', 'realId'];
const TITLE_KEYS = ['name', 'title', 'trackName', 'track_name'];
const ARTIST_KEYS = ['artistName', 'artist_name'];
const DURATION_KEYS = ['durationInMillis', 'durationMs', 'duration_ms', 'duration'];
type Obj = Record<string, unknown>;
const firstString = (o: Obj, keys: string[]) =>
  keys.map((k) => o[k]).find((v): v is string | number => (typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '') || typeof v === 'number')?.toString().trim();
const firstNumber = (o: Obj, keys: string[]) => keys.map((k) => o[k]).find((v): v is number => typeof v === 'number');
const toDurationMs = (n: number | undefined) => (!n || n <= 0 ? 0 : n < 10_000 ? n * 1000 : n);

function artistNames(o: Obj): string | null {
  const artists = o.artists ?? o.artist;
  if (typeof artists === 'string') return artists;
  if (Array.isArray(artists)) {
    return artists.map((a) => (typeof a === 'string' ? a : a && typeof a === 'object' ? firstString(a as Obj, ['name', 'artistName', 'title']) : null)).filter(Boolean).join(', ') || null;
  }
  if (artists && typeof artists === 'object') return firstString(artists as Obj, ['name', 'artistName', 'title']) ?? null;
  return null;
}

function collectCandidates(root: unknown, into: Candidate[] = []): Candidate[] {
  if (Array.isArray(root)) root.forEach((r) => collectCandidates(r, into));
  else if (root && typeof root === 'object') {
    const o = root as Obj;
    const details = (o.attributes && typeof o.attributes === 'object' ? o.attributes : o) as Obj;
    const id = firstString(o, ID_KEYS) ?? firstString(details, ID_KEYS);
    const title = firstString(details, TITLE_KEYS);
    if (id && title) {
      into.push({ id, title, artist: firstString(details, ARTIST_KEYS) ?? artistNames(details) ?? '', durationMs: toDurationMs(firstNumber(details, DURATION_KEYS)) });
    }
    Object.values(o).forEach((v) => collectCandidates(v, into));
  }
  return into;
}

function textScore(candidate: string, wanted: string, exact: number, partial: number): number {
  const c = candidate.toLowerCase();
  const w = wanted.toLowerCase();
  if (!c.trim() || !w.trim()) return 0;
  if (c === w) return exact;
  return c.includes(w) || w.includes(c) ? partial : 0;
}

function bestCandidate(root: unknown, q: LyricsQuery): Candidate | null {
  let best: { c: Candidate; score: number } | null = null;
  for (const c of collectCandidates(root)) {
    let score = textScore(c.title, q.title, 20, 10) + textScore(c.artist, q.artist, 15, 5);
    if (q.durationMs > 0 && c.durationMs > 0) {
      const diff = Math.abs(c.durationMs - q.durationMs);
      score += diff < 3000 ? 10 : diff < 10_000 ? 5 : 0;
    }
    if (!best || score > best.score) best = { c, score };
  }
  return best && best.score >= 10 ? best.c : null;
}

/** PaxSenix's structured Apple payload, keeping its syllable timings (PaxSenix.parseTimedApple). */
export function parsePaxSenixTimed(raw: string): LyricLine[] | null {
  const root = json<unknown>(raw);
  const find = (node: unknown): Obj[] | null => {
    if (Array.isArray(node)) {
      for (const n of node) {
        const found = find(n);
        if (found) return found;
      }
      return null;
    }
    if (node && typeof node === 'object') {
      const content = (node as Obj).content;
      if (Array.isArray(content) && content.some((c) => c && typeof c === 'object' && 'timestamp' in c)) return content as Obj[];
      for (const v of Object.values(node as Obj)) {
        const found = find(v);
        if (found) return found;
      }
    }
    return null;
  };
  const rows = find(root);
  if (!rows) return null;
  const lines: LyricLine[] = [];
  rows.forEach((row, index) => {
    const start = typeof row.timestamp === 'number' ? row.timestamp : null;
    const wordRows = Array.isArray(row.text) ? (row.text as Obj[]) : null;
    if (start === null || !wordRows) return;
    const texts = wordRows.map((w) => (typeof w.text === 'string' ? w.text : null)).filter((t): t is string => t !== null);
    if (!texts.length) return;
    const nextLine = typeof rows[index + 1]?.timestamp === 'number' ? (rows[index + 1]!.timestamp as number) : null;
    const runs: TimedRun[] = [];
    wordRows.forEach((word, i) => {
      const text = typeof word.text === 'string' ? word.text.trim() : '';
      if (!text || typeof word.timestamp !== 'number') return;
      const next = wordRows[i + 1];
      const end = typeof word.endtime === 'number' ? word.endtime : typeof next?.timestamp === 'number' ? next.timestamp : (nextLine ?? word.timestamp + 800);
      runs.push({ startMs: word.timestamp, endMs: end, raw: word.part === true ? text : `${text} ` });
    });
    const timed = wordsFromRuns(runs, true);
    const untimed = runs.length !== texts.filter((t) => t.trim()).length;
    lines.push(
      line(Math.min(start, timed[0]?.startMs ?? start), untimed ? texts.map((t) => t.trim()).join(' ') : timed.map((w) => w.text).join(' '), {
        words: untimed ? [] : timed,
        sungUntilMs: nextLine,
      }),
    );
  });
  const out = withInstrumentalGaps(lines);
  return out.some((l) => l.text.trim()) ? out : null;
}

const paxResponse = (raw: string | null): Parsed | null => (raw ? fromLines(parsePaxSenixTimed(raw)) ?? parseProvider(raw) : null);

export async function paxSenix(q: LyricsQuery): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  const token = await appleWebToken();
  if (!token) return null;
  const search = await lyricsGet(
    urlWith('https://amp-api.music.apple.com/v1/catalog/us/search', { term: `${q.title} ${q.artist}`, types: 'songs', limit: 10, l: 'en-US' }),
    { route: 'extension', headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
  );
  const id = bestCandidate(json(search), q)?.id;
  if (!id) return null;
  return paxResponse(await lyricsGet(urlWith('https://lyrics.paxsenix.org/apple-music/lyrics', { id, ttml: 'true' })));
}

function paxApi(path: string, params: Record<string, string>, key: string) {
  return lyricsGet(urlWith(`https://api.paxsenix.org/${path}`, params), {
    route: 'extension',
    patient: true,
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim()}` },
  });
}

async function paxGeneric(q: LyricsQuery, key: string): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  const raw = await paxApi('lyrics/lrcget', { q: `${q.title} ${q.artist}` }, key);
  const root = json<{ lyrics?: unknown[] }>(raw);
  const documents = Array.isArray(root?.lyrics) ? root.lyrics : null;
  if (!documents?.length) return paxResponse(raw);
  // Candidates, not lines: pick one recording before parsing (PaxSenix.parseLrcGet).
  const scored = documents
    .map((document) => {
      const parsed = paxResponse(JSON.stringify(document));
      if (!parsed) return null;
      const c = collectCandidates([document])[0];
      const score = c ? textScore(c.title, q.title, 20, 10) + textScore(c.artist, q.artist, 15, 5) : 0;
      const last = Math.max(0, ...parsed.lines.map((l) => Math.max(l.timeMs, l.sungUntilMs ?? 0, l.words.at(-1)?.endMs ?? 0)));
      return { parsed, score, distance: q.durationMs > 0 ? Math.abs(last - q.durationMs) : 0 };
    })
    .filter((x): x is NonNullable<typeof x> => !!x)
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.distance - b.distance);
  return scored[0]?.parsed ?? null;
}

export async function paxSenixSpotify(q: LyricsQuery, key: string): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  if (!key) return null;
  const id = bestCandidate(json(await paxApi('spotify/search', { q: `${q.title} ${q.artist}` }, key)), q)?.id;
  return (id ? paxResponse(await paxApi('lyrics/spotify', { id }, key)) : null) ?? paxGeneric(q, key);
}

export async function paxSenixMusixmatch(q: LyricsQuery, key: string): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  if (!key) return null;
  const found = paxResponse(await paxApi('lyrics/musixmatch', { t: q.title, a: q.artist, d: String(Math.floor(q.durationMs / 1000)) }, key));
  return found ?? paxGeneric(q, key);
}

// ---- LyricsPlus (LyricsPlus.kt) ------------------------------------------------------------------

// atomix.one (bad certificate), prjktla.workers.dev (worker deleted) and the
// two vercel.app deployments (disabled, 402) were dropped on 2026-10-17.
const MIRRORS = ['https://lyricsplus.prjktla.my.id', 'https://lyricsplus.binimum.org'];
let lastGoodMirror: string | null = null;

interface LyricsPlusResponse {
  lyrics?: { time?: number; duration?: number; text?: string; syllabus?: { time?: number; duration?: number; text?: string }[]; element?: unknown }[];
  metadata?: { agents?: Record<string, { type?: string; alias?: string }> };
}

export function parseLyricsPlus(response: LyricsPlusResponse): LyricLine[] {
  const sung: { line: LyricLine; element: unknown }[] = [];
  for (const l of response.lyrics ?? []) {
    if (typeof l.time !== 'number') continue;
    const words = wordsFromRuns(
      (l.syllabus ?? [])
        .filter((s) => typeof s.text === 'string' && typeof s.time === 'number')
        .map((s) => ({ startMs: s.time!, endMs: s.time! + (s.duration ?? 0), raw: s.text! })),
      true,
    );
    let built: LyricLine | null = null;
    if (words.length) built = line(Math.min(l.time, words[0]!.startMs), words.map((w) => w.text).join(' '), { words });
    else if (l.text?.trim()) built = line(l.time, l.text.trim(), { sungUntilMs: l.duration && l.duration > 0 ? l.time + l.duration : null });
    if (built) sung.push({ line: built, element: l.element });
  }
  sung.sort((a, b) => a.line.timeMs - b.line.timeMs);
  const types: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [id, agent] of Object.entries(response.metadata?.agents ?? {})) if (agent.type) types[agent.alias ?? id] = agent.type;
  const singer = (element: unknown) =>
    element && typeof element === 'object' && !Array.isArray(element) && typeof (element as Obj).singer === 'string' ? ((element as Obj).singer as string) : null;
  const sides = lineAlignments(sung.map((s) => singer(s.element)), types);
  return withInstrumentalGaps(
    sung.map((s, i) => {
      const opposite = Array.isArray(s.element) && s.element.some((tag) => tag === 'opposite' || tag === 'right');
      return { ...s.line, alignment: sides[i] === 'end' || opposite ? ('end' as const) : ('start' as const) };
    }),
  );
}

export async function lyricsPlus(q: LyricsQuery): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  const hosts = lastGoodMirror ? [lastGoodMirror, ...MIRRORS.filter((m) => m !== lastGoodMirror)] : MIRRORS;
  // All at once; the first mirror with something usable wins (a 404 doesn't).
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let pending = hosts.length;
    let done = false;
    for (const host of hosts) {
      void (async () => {
        const body = json<LyricsPlusResponse>(
          await lyricsGet(urlWith(`${host}/v2/lyrics/get`, { title: q.title, artist: q.artist, duration: seconds(q.durationMs), album: q.album, isrc: q.isrc })),
        );
        const lines = body ? parseLyricsPlus(body) : [];
        if (!done && lines.length) {
          done = true;
          lastGoodMirror = host;
          resolve({ lines, ttml: null });
        }
        if (--pending === 0 && !done) resolve(null);
      })();
    }
  });
}

// ---- YouTube (YouTubeLyrics.kt) -----------------------------------------------------------------

function* objectsNamed(node: unknown, name: string): Generator<Obj> {
  if (Array.isArray(node)) for (const n of node) yield* objectsNamed(n, name);
  else if (node && typeof node === 'object') {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(node as Obj)) {
      if (key === name && value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) yield value as Obj;
      yield* objectsNamed(value, name);
    }
  }
}

function youtubeText(node: unknown): string {
  if (typeof node === 'string') return node;
  if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.map(youtubeText).join('');
  if (node && typeof node === 'object') {
    const o = node as Obj;
    if (typeof o.text === 'string') return o.text;
    if (typeof o.simpleText === 'string') return o.simpleText;
    return Object.values(o).map(youtubeText).join('');
  }
  return '';
}

/** Plain lyrics from the Lyrics tab of the exact playing video. */
export async function youtubeMusicLyrics(q: LyricsQuery): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}$/.test(q.videoId)) return null;
  try {
    const { getMusicClient } = await import('@/playback/youtube/innertube');
    const yt = await getMusicClient();
    const shelf = await yt.music.getLyrics(q.videoId);
    const text = shelf?.description?.toString().trim();
    return text ? fromLines(text.split(/\r?\n/).map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((t) => line(0, t))) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Timed captions for the exact playing video (Innertube.transcript). */
export async function youtubeCaptions(q: LyricsQuery): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}$/.test(q.videoId)) return null;
  try {
    const { getMusicClient } = await import('@/playback/youtube/innertube');
    const yt = await getMusicClient();
    // get_transcript takes a tiny protobuf: field 1, length, the video id.
    const id = new TextEncoder().encode(q.videoId);
    const params = btoa(String.fromCharCode(10, id.length, ...id));
    const response = await yt.actions.execute('/get_transcript', { params, client: 'YTMUSIC' });
    const lines = [...objectsNamed(response.data, 'transcriptCueRenderer')]
      .map((cue) => {
        const start = Number(cue.startOffsetMs);
        const text = youtubeText(cue.cue).replace(/^[\s♪]+|[\s♪]+$/g, '');
        return Number.isFinite(start) && text ? line(start, text) : null;
      })
      .filter((l): l is LyricLine => !!l)
      .sort((a, b) => a.timeMs - b.timeMs);
    return fromLines(lines);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ---- KuGou (KuGou.kt) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const stripParenthetical = (s: string) => s.replace(/[(（].*?[)）]/g, '').trim() || s;
const KUGOU_STAMPED = /^\[\d{2}:\d{2}\.\d{2,3}\].*/;
const KUGOU_CREDIT = /.+\][^[]+[:：].+/;

/** KuGou files open and close with credit lines ("作词: …") stamped like lyrics; cut them. */
export function stripKugouCredits(lrc: string): string {
  const lines = lrc.split(/\r?\n/).filter((l) => KUGOU_STAMPED.test(l));
  if (!lines.length) return '';
  let head = 0;
  for (let i = Math.min(30, lines.length - 1); i >= 0; i--) {
    if (KUGOU_CREDIT.test(lines[i]!)) {
      head = i + 1;
      break;
    }
  }
  const body = lines.slice(head);
  let tail = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= Math.min(30, body.length - 1); i++) {
    if (KUGOU_CREDIT.test(body[body.length - 1 - i]!)) {
      tail = i + 1;
      break;
    }
  }
  return body.slice(0, body.length - tail).join('\n');
}

const KUGOU_STAMP = /\[\d{2}:\d{2}\.\d{2,3}\]/g;
const KUGOU_INSTRUMENTAL = /纯音乐.*欣赏/;

/** A file holding nothing but KuGou's "纯音乐，请欣赏" ("pure music, please enjoy") notice. */
export function isKugouInstrumentalNotice(lrc: string): boolean {
  const lines = lrc.split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.replace(KUGOU_STAMP, '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return lines.length > 0 && lines.every((l) => KUGOU_INSTRUMENTAL.test(l));
}

export async function kugou(q: LyricsQuery): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  const keyword = `${stripParenthetical(q.title)} - ${stripParenthetical(q.artist)}${q.album ? ` ${q.album}` : ''}`;
  const secs = Math.floor(q.durationMs / 1000);
  const ext = { route: 'extension' as const };
  const songs = json<{ data?: { info?: { hash: string; duration?: number }[] } }>(
    await lyricsGet(urlWith('https://mobileservice.kugou.com/api/v3/search/song', { version: 9108, plat: 0, pagesize: 8, showtype: 0, keyword }), ext),
  );
  const hashes = (songs?.data?.info ?? [])
    .filter((s) => secs <= 0 || Math.abs((s.duration ?? -1) - secs) <= 8)
    .sort((a, b) => Math.abs((a.duration ?? 0) - secs) - Math.abs((b.duration ?? 0) - secs))
    .map((s) => s.hash);
  type Candidates = { candidates?: { id: string; accesskey: string }[] };
  let candidate: { id: string; accesskey: string } | undefined;
  for (const hash of hashes) {
    candidate = json<Candidates>(await lyricsGet(urlWith('https://lyrics.kugou.com/search', { ver: 1, man: 'yes', client: 'pc', hash }), ext))?.candidates?.[0];
    if (candidate) break;
  }
  candidate ??= json<Candidates>(
    await lyricsGet(urlWith('https://lyrics.kugou.com/search', { ver: 1, man: 'yes', client: 'pc', keyword, duration: secs > 0 ? secs * 1000 : null }), ext),
  )?.candidates?.[0];
  if (!candidate) return null;
  const download = json<{ content?: string }>(
    await lyricsGet(urlWith('https://lyrics.kugou.com/download', { fmt: 'lrc', charset: 'utf8', client: 'pc', ver: 1, id: candidate.id, accesskey: candidate.accesskey }), ext),
  );
  if (!download?.content) return null;
  try {
    const lrc = new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(atob(download.content), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0)));
    const stripped = stripKugouCredits(lrc);
    if (isKugouInstrumentalNotice(stripped)) return null;
    return fromLines(parseLrc(stripped));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ---- LRCLIB (LrcLib.kt) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const LRCLIB_NOISE = /\((?:from|feat\.?|official|lyrical|video|audio|remix)[^)]*\)|\[[^\]]*\]|\b(?:official (?:video|audio|music video)|lyrical|full song|4k video)\b/gi;
const lrclibClean = (s: string) => s.replace(LRCLIB_NOISE, ' ').split(' | ')[0]!.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() || s;

export async function lrclib(q: LyricsQuery): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  const title = lrclibClean(q.title);
  const artist = lrclibClean(q.artist);
  const secs = Math.floor(q.durationMs / 1000);
  const exact = json<{ syncedLyrics?: string }>(
    await lyricsGet(urlWith('https://lrclib.net/api/get', { track_name: title, artist_name: artist, duration: secs })),
  )?.syncedLyrics;
  let synced = exact;
  if (!synced) {
    const hits = json<{ syncedLyrics?: string; duration?: number }[]>(await lyricsGet(urlWith('https://lrclib.net/api/search', { track_name: title, artist_name: artist })));
    synced = (hits ?? [])
      .filter((h) => h.syncedLyrics?.trim())
      .sort((a, b) => Math.abs((a.duration ?? 0) - secs) - Math.abs((b.duration ?? 0) - secs))[0]?.syncedLyrics;
  }
  return synced ? fromLines(parseLrc(synced)) : null;
}

// ---- Musixmatch (Musixmatch.kt) -------------------------------------------------------------------

const MXM = 'https://apic.musixmatch.com/ws/1.1';
const MXM_APP = 'mobile-app-v1.0';
const MXM_FALLBACK_SECRET = 'f09016176ba43a1cfd1031fbd6b3d26c';
const mxmGuid = crypto.randomUUID();
let mxmSecret: string | null = null;
let mxmToken: string | null = null;

async function musixmatchSecret(): Promise<string> {
  if (mxmSecret) return mxmSecret;
  const ext = { route: 'extension' as const };
  try {
    const page = await lyricsGet('https://www.musixmatch.com/search', ext);
    const script = page?.match(/src=["']([^"']*\/_next\/static\/chunks\/pages\/_app-[^"']+\.js)["']/i)?.[1];
    const source = script ? await lyricsGet(new URL(script, 'https://www.musixmatch.com/search').toString(), ext) : null;
    const encoded = source?.match(/from\(\s*["']([^"']+)["']\s*\.split/)?.[1];
    const decoded = encoded ? atob([...encoded].reverse().join('')) : '';
    mxmSecret = decoded.trim() || MXM_FALLBACK_SECRET;
  } catch {
    mxmSecret = MXM_FALLBACK_SECRET;
  }
  return mxmSecret;
}

/** Signs `<url><UTC yyyyMMdd>` with HMAC-SHA256, as Musixmatch's web client does. */
async function mxmSign(url: string, secret: string): Promise<string> {
  const normalizedUrl = url.replace(/%20/g, '+').replace(/ /g, '+');
  const now = new Date();
  const date = `${now.getUTCFullYear()}${String(now.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}${String(now.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(secret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
  const raw = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, new TextEncoder().encode(`${normalizedUrl}${date}`)));
  const signature = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...raw));
  return `${normalizedUrl}&signature=${encodeURIComponent(signature)}&signature_protocol=sha256`;
}

async function mxmGet(build: (token: string) => string): Promise<Obj | null> {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
    const secret = await musixmatchSecret();
    if (!mxmToken) {
      const body = json<{ message?: { body?: { user_token?: string } } }>(
        await lyricsGet(await mxmSign(urlWith(`${MXM}/token.get`, { app_id: MXM_APP, guid: mxmGuid, format: 'json' }), secret), { route: 'extension' }),
      );
      mxmToken = body?.message?.body?.user_token ?? null;
      if (!mxmToken) return null;
    }
    const body = json<{ message?: { header?: { status_code?: number }; body?: Obj } }>(
      await lyricsGet(await mxmSign(build(mxmToken), secret), { route: 'extension' }),
    );
    const status = body?.message?.header?.status_code;
    if (body && status !== 401 && status !== 402) return body.message?.body ?? null;
    // An expired token or rotated key: refresh both once.
    mxmToken = null;
    mxmSecret = null;
  }
  return null;
}

/** Rich sync, without flattening it through LRC (Musixmatch.parseRichSyncBody). */
export function parseRichSync(body: string): LyricLine[] {
  const entries = json<{ ts: number; te: number; l?: { c: string; o: number }[]; x?: string }[]>(body) ?? [];
  const lines = entries
    .map((entry) => {
      const lineStart = Math.trunc(entry.ts * 1000);
      const lineEnd = Math.max(lineStart, Math.trunc(entry.te * 1000));
      let previous = lineStart;
      const fragments = entry.l ?? [];
      const runs: TimedRun[] = [];
      fragments.forEach((fragment, index) => {
        if (!fragment.c) return;
        const start = Math.max(lineStart, previous, Math.trunc((entry.ts + fragment.o) * 1000));
        const next = fragments[index + 1];
        const until = next ? Math.trunc((entry.ts + next.o) * 1000) : lineEnd;
        previous = start;
        runs.push({ startMs: start, endMs: Math.max(start, Math.min(lineEnd, until)), raw: fragment.c });
      });
      const words = wordsFromRuns(runs, true);
      const text = (entry.x ?? '').trim() || words.map((w) => w.text).join(' ');
      return text ? line(Math.min(lineStart, words[0]?.startMs ?? lineStart), text, { words, sungUntilMs: lineEnd > lineStart ? lineEnd : null }) : null;
    })
    .filter((l): l is LyricLine => !!l)
    .sort((a, b) => a.timeMs - b.timeMs);
  return withInstrumentalGaps(lines);
}

export async function musixmatch(q: LyricsQuery): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  const secs = Math.floor(q.durationMs / 1000);
  const search = await mxmGet((token) =>
    urlWith(`${MXM}/track.search`, {
      app_id: MXM_APP, format: 'json', q_track: q.title, q_artist: q.artist, f_has_lyrics: 1,
      s_track_rating: 'desc', quorum_factor: 1, page_size: 10, page: 1, usertoken: token,
    }),
  );
  type Track = { track_id: number; track_name: string; artist_name?: string; track_length?: number; has_subtitles?: number; has_richsync?: number };
  const tracks = ((search?.track_list as { track: Track }[] | undefined) ?? []).map((t) => t.track);
  const score = (t: Track) => {
    const name = t.track_name.trim().toLowerCase();
    const want = q.title.trim().toLowerCase();
    let s = name === want ? 80 : name.includes(want) || want.includes(name) ? 40 : 0;
    if ((t.artist_name ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q.artist.toLowerCase())) s += 40;
    if (t.track_length != null) {
      const diff = Math.abs(t.track_length - secs);
      s += diff <= 2 ? 30 : diff <= 5 ? 15 : diff <= 10 ? 5 : -20;
    }
    return s;
  };
  const track = tracks.sort((a, b) => score(b) - score(a))[0];
  if (!track) return null;
  if (track.has_richsync) {
    const rich = await mxmGet((token) => urlWith(`${MXM}/track.richsync.get`, { app_id: MXM_APP, format: 'json', track_id: track.track_id, usertoken: token }));
    const body = (rich?.richsync as { richsync_body?: string } | undefined)?.richsync_body;
    const lines = body ? parseRichSync(body) : [];
    if (lines.some((l) => l.words.length)) return { lines, ttml: null };
  }
  if (!track.has_subtitles) return null;
  const subtitle = await mxmGet((token) =>
    urlWith(`${MXM}/track.subtitle.get`, { app_id: MXM_APP, format: 'json', track_id: track.track_id, subtitle_format: 'mxm', usertoken: token }),
  );
  const body = (subtitle?.subtitle as { subtitle_body?: string } | undefined)?.subtitle_body;
  const entries = json<{ text: string; time: { total: number } }[]>(body ?? null) ?? [];
  return fromLines(entries.filter((e) => e.text.trim()).map((e) => line(Math.trunc(e.time.total * 1000), e.text.trim())));
}

// ---- Genius (Genius.kt) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const GENIUS_NOISE =
  /\s*[([]\s*(?:from|feat\.?|ft\.?|featuring|with|prod\.?|produced by|official|lyrical|video|audio|remix|music video|visualizer|mv|hd|4k|hq|full song)[^)\]]*[)\]]|\s*\b(?:official\s+(?:music\s+)?(?:video|audio)|lyrical(?:\s+video)?|full\s+song|4k\s+video|hd\s+video|music\s+video)\b/gi;
const geniusClean = (s: string) =>
  s
    .replace(/[♪♫★☆【】《》「」~_]/g, ' ')
    .replace(GENIUS_NOISE, ' ')
    .replace(/\b(?:prod(?:uced)?\.?(?:\s+by)?)\s+.*$/i, ' ')
    .split(' | ')[0]!
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim() || s.trim();

/** Genius's page HTML to lines, keeping "[Chorus]" headers and stanza breaks. */
export function parseGeniusHtml(html: string): LyricLine[] {
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
  let containers = [...doc.querySelectorAll('div[data-lyrics-container="true"]')];
  if (!containers.length) containers = [...doc.querySelectorAll('div.lyrics')];
  let text = '';
  for (const container of containers) {
    container
      .querySelectorAll('[data-exclude-from-selection="true"], [class*="LyricsHeader__Container"], [class*="SongBioPreview"], [class*="InreadAd"], button, script, style')
      .forEach((n) => n.remove());
    container.querySelectorAll('br').forEach((br) => br.replaceWith('\n'));
    text += `${container.textContent ?? ''}\n`;
  }
  const cleaned = text
    .replace(/[  ﻿]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\d*You might also like/gi, '')
    .trim()
    .replace(/\d*Embed\s*$/i, '')
    .trim();
  const out: LyricLine[] = [];
  for (const raw of cleaned.split('\n')) {
    const t = raw.trim().replace(/\d*Embed\s*$/i, '').trim();
    if (!t) {
      if (out.length && out.at(-1)!.text) out.push(line(0, ''));
    } else out.push(line(0, decodeEntities(t)));
  }
  while (out.length && !out[0]!.text) out.shift();
  while (out.length && !out.at(-1)!.text) out.pop();
  return out;
}

export async function genius(q: LyricsQuery): Promise<Parsed | null> {
  const title = geniusClean(q.title);
  const artist = geniusClean(q.artist);
  const bare = title.replace(/\s*[([].*?[)\]]/g, ' ').replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const attempts = [...new Set([`${artist} ${title}`.trim(), `${artist} ${bare}`.trim(), bare || title])];
  for (const query of attempts) {
    const body = json<{ response?: { sections?: { type?: string; hits?: { result?: Obj }[] }[] } }>(
      await lyricsGet(urlWith('https://genius.com/api/search/multi', { q: query }), { route: 'extension' }),
    );
    const hits = body?.response?.sections?.find((s) => s.type === 'song')?.hits?.map((h) => h.result).filter((r): r is Obj => !!r) ?? [];
    const t = (bare || title).toLowerCase();
    const a = artist.toLowerCase();
    const scored = hits
      .map((hit) => {
        const ht = String(hit.title ?? '').toLowerCase();
        const ha = String(hit.artist_names ?? '').toLowerCase();
        const titleMatch = !!t && (ht === t || ht.includes(t) || t.includes(ht));
        const artistMatch = !!a && (ha === a || ha.includes(a) || a.includes(ha));
        if (!titleMatch && !artistMatch) return null;
        let score = (ht === t ? 50 : titleMatch ? 25 : 0) + (artistMatch ? (ha === a ? 40 : 20) : 0);
        const path = String(hit.path ?? '');
        if (/translation/i.test(path) && !t.includes('translation')) score -= 30;
        if (/tracklist|album-art/i.test(path)) score -= 50;
        return score > 0 ? { hit, score } : null;
      })
      .filter((x): x is { hit: Obj; score: number } => !!x)
      .sort((x, y) => y.score - x.score);
    const url = scored[0]?.hit.url;
    if (typeof url !== 'string') continue;
    const html = await lyricsGet(url, { route: 'extension' });
    const lines = html ? parseGeniusHtml(html) : [];
    if (lines.length) return { lines, ttml: null };
  }
  return null;
}

File: web/app/src/lyrics/repository.ts

import { withBackgroundVocals, type LyricLine } from './model';
import { lyricsGet } from './http';
import type { Parsed } from './parse';
import * as providers from './providers';
import { enabledSources, useLyricsSettings } from './settings';
import { artistForLyricsSearch, forLyricsSearch, sourceById, type LyricsSourceId } from './sources';
import { writeTtml } from './ttml';

/**
 * Where the player gets its lyrics: a port of LyricsRepository.kt.
 *
 * - Every enabled source is asked at the same time, but their answers are
 *   taken in priority order: a lower source finishing first never preempts a
 *   higher one still pending.
 * - A word-timed answer wins outright. Otherwise the highest-priority timed
 *   answer is taken, unless "prefer syllable timing" is on, in which case
 *   the search carries on for a word-timed one and the line-timed answer is
 *   kept as a fallback.
 * - Before anyone is asked, BiniLyrics names the recording (an ISRC, in at
 *   most 2.5 s), so lrc.red and LyricsPlus can ask by recording, not name.
 * - Genius (a scraper) is only asked once every source above it has missed.
 */

export interface LyricsTrack {
  videoId: string;
  title: string;
  artist: string;
  durationMs: number;
  album: string | null;
}

export interface LyricsResult {
  source: LyricsSourceId;
  label: string;
  lines: LyricLine[];
  /** What am-lyrics renders: the provider's own TTML, or ours written from the lines. */
  ttml: string;
  wordSynced: boolean;
  synced: boolean;
}

/** One provider's part in a lookup, for the provider picker. */
export type SourceState = 'pending' | 'found' | 'missing';

const IDENTIFY_TIMEOUT_MS = 2500;
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 12 * 60 * 60_000;

/** The recording behind a video id, once something worked it out (bounded, memory only). */
const isrcs = new Map<string, string>();
function remember(videoId: string, isrc: string | null | undefined) {
  if (!isrc || !videoId) return;
  isrcs.delete(videoId);
  isrcs.set(videoId, isrc);
  if (isrcs.size > 100) isrcs.delete(isrcs.keys().next().value!);
}

const cache = new Map<string, { at: number; result: LyricsResult | null }>();

/** Drops every remembered answer: a newly allowed host may have what was missing. */
export function forgetLyrics() {
  cache.clear();
}

function toResult(source: LyricsSourceId, parsed: Parsed): LyricsResult {
  const lines = withBackgroundVocals(parsed.lines);
  return {
    source,
    label: sourceById(source)?.label ?? source,
    lines,
    ttml: parsed.ttml ?? writeTtml(lines),
    wordSynced: lines.some((l) => l.words.length),
    synced: lines.some((l) => l.timeMs > 0 || l.words.length),
  };
}

function withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number): Promise<T | null> {
  return Promise.race([promise, new Promise<null>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(null), ms))]);
}

export interface LookupOptions {
  /** Ask this one provider only: the panel's provider picker. */
  only?: LyricsSourceId;
  onSource?: (source: LyricsSourceId, state: SourceState) => void;
}

export async function lookupLyrics(track: LyricsTrack, { only, onSource }: LookupOptions = {}): Promise<LyricsResult | null> {
  const sequence = only ? [only] : enabledSources();
  if (!sequence.length) return null;
  const key = `${track.videoId}|${track.durationMs}|${track.title}|${track.artist}|${only ?? ''}|${sequence.join(',')}`;
  const cached = cache.get(key);
  if (cached && Date.now() - cached.at < CACHE_TTL_MS) return cached.result;

  const query: providers.LyricsQuery = {
    videoId: track.videoId,
    title: forLyricsSearch(track.title),
    artist: artistForLyricsSearch(track.artist),
    durationMs: track.durationMs,
    album: track.album,
    isrc: isrcs.get(track.videoId) ?? null,
  };
  let hit: providers.BiniHit | null = null;
  if (!query.isrc && sequence.includes('bini')) {
    hit = await withTimeout(providers.biniIdentify(query).catch(() => null), IDENTIFY_TIMEOUT_MS);
    if (hit?.isrc) {
      remember(track.videoId, hit.isrc);
      query.isrc = hit.isrc;
    }
  }

  const documents = new Map<string, Promise<string | null>>();
  const get: providers.SharedGet = (url) => {
    let pending = documents.get(url);
    if (!pending) {
      pending = lyricsGet(url);
      documents.set(url, pending);
    }
    return pending;
  };
  const { paxsenixKey, preferSyllables } = useLyricsSettings.getState();

  const fetchFrom = (source: LyricsSourceId): Promise<Parsed | null> => {
    switch (source) {
      case 'lrc-red':
        return providers.lrcRed(query, get);
      case 'bini':
        return providers.bini(query, get, hit).then((found) => {
          remember(track.videoId, found?.isrc);
          return found;
        });
      case 'better-lyrics':
        return providers.betterLyrics(query);
      case 'better-lyrics-portato':
        return providers.betterLyricsPortato(query);
      case 'paxsenix':
        return providers.paxSenix(query);
      case 'paxsenix-spotify':
        return providers.paxSenixSpotify(query, paxsenixKey);
      case 'paxsenix-musixmatch':
        return providers.paxSenixMusixmatch(query, paxsenixKey);
      case 'lyrics-plus':
        return providers.lyricsPlus(query);
      case 'unison':
        return providers.unison(query);
      case 'youtube-captions':
        return providers.youtubeCaptions(query);
      case 'youtube-music':
        return providers.youtubeMusicLyrics(query);
      case 'kugou':
        return providers.kugou(query);
      case 'lrclib':
        return providers.lrclib(query);
      case 'musixmatch':
        return providers.musixmatch(query);
      case 'genius':
        return providers.genius(query);
    }
  };

  const run = (source: LyricsSourceId) => {
    onSource?.(source, 'pending');
    return fetchFrom(source)
      .catch(() => null)
      .then((parsed) => {
        const result = parsed?.lines.some((l) => l.text.trim()) ? toResult(source, parsed) : null;
        onSource?.(source, result ? 'found' : 'missing');
        return result;
      });
  };

  // Genius starts lazily: only if it's reached.
  const racing = sequence.map((source) => ({ source, job: source === 'genius' ? null : run(source) }));
  let lineSynced: LyricsResult | null = null;
  let plain: LyricsResult | null = null;
  let winner: LyricsResult | null = null;
  for (const entry of racing) {
    if (entry.source === 'genius' && (lineSynced || plain)) continue;
    const found = await (entry.job ?? run(entry.source));
    if (!found) continue;
    if (found.wordSynced) {
      winner = found;
      break;
    }
    if (found.synced && !preferSyllables) {
      winner = found;
      break;
    }
    if (found.synced) lineSynced ??= found;
    else plain ??= found;
  }
  winner ??= lineSynced ?? plain;
  cache.set(key, { at: Date.now(), result: winner });
  return winner;
}

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { LYRICS_SOURCES, orderedSources, type LyricsSourceId } from './sources';

/**
 * Which lyric providers are asked, and in what order (the desktop's lyric
 * settings). Kept in localStorage; a source added in a later build lands
 * where a fresh install would put it (sources.orderedSources).
 */
interface LyricsSettings {
  order: LyricsSourceId[];
  disabled: LyricsSourceId[];
  /** Keep looking past a line-timed answer for a word-timed one (LyricsRepository.prioritizeSyllableSync). */
  preferSyllables: boolean;
  /** PaxSenix's Spotify and Musixmatch routes need the user's own key. */
  paxsenixKey: string;
  setEnabled: (id: LyricsSourceId, on: boolean) => void;
  move: (id: LyricsSourceId, by: -1 | 1) => void;
  setPreferSyllables: (on: boolean) => void;
  setPaxsenixKey: (key: string) => void;
  reset: () => void;
}

const KEY = 'bitchord:lyrics';
type Saved = Pick<LyricsSettings, 'order' | 'disabled' | 'preferSyllables' | 'paxsenixKey'>;

const DEFAULTS: Saved = {
  order: LYRICS_SOURCES.map((s) => s.id),
  // The keyed routes do nothing without a key; off until one is entered.
  disabled: ['paxsenix-spotify', 'paxsenix-musixmatch'],
  preferSyllables: false,
  paxsenixKey: '',
};

function load(): Saved {
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) ?? '{}') as Partial<Saved>;
    return { ...DEFAULTS, ...saved, order: orderedSources(saved.order ?? DEFAULTS.order) };
  } catch {
    return DEFAULTS;
  }
}

export const useLyricsSettings = create<LyricsSettings>()((set, get) => {
  const save = (change: Partial<Saved>) => {
    set(change);
    const { order, disabled, preferSyllables, paxsenixKey } = get();
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify({ order, disabled, preferSyllables, paxsenixKey }));
  };
  return {
    ...load(),
    setEnabled: (id, on) => save({ disabled: on ? get().disabled.filter((d) => d !== id) : [...new Set([...get().disabled, id])] }),
    move: (id, by) => {
      const order = [...get().order];
      const at = order.indexOf(id);
      const to = at + by;
      if (at < 0 || to < 0 || to >= order.length) return;
      [order[at], order[to]] = [order[to]!, order[at]!];
      save({ order });
    },
    setPreferSyllables: (preferSyllables) => save({ preferSyllables }),
    setPaxsenixKey: (paxsenixKey) => save({ paxsenixKey: paxsenixKey.trim() }),
    reset: () => save(DEFAULTS),
  };
});

/** The sources that will be asked, in the order they're asked. */
export function enabledSources(): LyricsSourceId[] {
  const { order, disabled } = useLyricsSettings.getState();
  return order.filter((id) => !disabled.includes(id));
}

/**
 * The lyric providers, in default priority: LyricsSource.kt's declaration
 * order, minus its hidden entries (SimpMusic and Megalobiz). The user can
 * reorder and switch them off, as on the desktop (useLyricsSettings).
 */
export const LYRICS_SOURCES = [
  { id: 'lrc-red', label: 'lrc.red', detail: 'Apple timings by recording, syllable by syllable', wordSynced: true },
  { id: 'bini', label: 'BiniLyrics', detail: 'The same Apple timings, matched on the recording itself', wordSynced: true },
  { id: 'better-lyrics', label: 'BetterLyrics', detail: 'Apple Music timings, word by word', wordSynced: true },
  { id: 'better-lyrics-portato', label: 'BetterLyrics Portato', detail: 'QQ Music karaoke timings through BetterLyrics', wordSynced: true },
  { id: 'paxsenix', label: 'PaxSenix', detail: 'Apple Music timings through the original keyless provider', wordSynced: true },
  { id: 'paxsenix-spotify', label: 'PaxSenix: Spotify', detail: 'Spotify lyrics with PaxSenix fallback; API key required', wordSynced: false },
  { id: 'paxsenix-musixmatch', label: 'PaxSenix: Musixmatch', detail: 'Musixmatch timings with PaxSenix fallback; API key required', wordSynced: true },
  { id: 'lyrics-plus', label: 'LyricsPlus', detail: 'Syllable by syllable, on community mirrors', wordSynced: true },
  { id: 'unison', label: 'Unison', detail: 'Contributed by listeners, so it has what nobody licensed', wordSynced: true },
  { id: 'youtube-captions', label: 'YouTube captions', detail: 'Timed captions matched to the exact playing video', wordSynced: false },
  { id: 'youtube-music', label: 'YouTube Music', detail: 'Plain lyrics from the playing video’s Lyrics tab', wordSynced: false },
  { id: 'kugou', label: 'KuGou', detail: 'Whole lines, strong outside the English catalogue', wordSynced: false },
  { id: 'lrclib', label: 'LRCLIB', detail: 'Whole lines only, and always up', wordSynced: false },
  { id: 'musixmatch', label: 'Musixmatch', detail: 'Whole lines, from the biggest lyrics database there is', wordSynced: false },
  { id: 'genius', label: 'Genius', detail: 'Plain text fallback, massive web catalogue', wordSynced: false },
] as const;

export type LyricsSourceId = (typeof LYRICS_SOURCES)[number]['id'];

export const sourceById = (id: string) => LYRICS_SOURCES.find((s) => s.id === id);

/**
 * A saved order brought up to date with this build (LyricsSource.ordered):
 * unknown ids dropped, and a source added since slotted in right after the
 * one it's declared behind, so it lands where a fresh install puts it.
 */
export function orderedSources(saved: readonly string[]): LyricsSourceId[] {
  const offered = LYRICS_SOURCES.map((s) => s.id);
  const result = [...new Set(saved)].filter((id): id is LyricsSourceId => (offered as readonly string[]).includes(id));
  offered.forEach((id, index) => {
    if (result.includes(id)) return;
    const before = offered.slice(0, index).reverse().find((b) => result.includes(b));
    result.splice(before ? result.indexOf(before) + 1 : 0, 0, id);
  });
  return result;
}

// ---- LyricsQuery.kt -------------------------------------------------------------------

const CREDITS = [
  /\s*[([]\s*(feat|ft|featuring|with)\b[^)\]]*[)\]]/gi,
  /\s+(feat|ft|featuring)\.?\s+.*$/gi,
  /\s*[([]\s*(official\s*)?(music\s*)?(video|audio|visuali[sz]er|lyrics?\s*video|lyrics?|m\/?v|hd|hq|4k|full\s*song)\s*[)\]]/gi,
  /\s*[([]\s*official\s*[)\]]/gi,
];

/** A YouTube title as a lyrics database indexed it: credits and packaging off, version words kept. */
export function forLyricsSearch(title: string): string {
  let name = title;
  for (const pattern of CREDITS) name = name.replace(pattern, ' ');
  const cleaned = name.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().replace(/[,\-–—]+$/, '').trim();
  return cleaned || title.trim();
}

/** " - Topic" off an auto-generated channel name. */
export function artistForLyricsSearch(artist: string): string {
  return artist.replace(/ - Topic$/, '').trim() || artist.trim();
}

File: web/app/src/lyrics/ttml.ts

import { isGap, type LyricLine, type LyricWord } from './model';

/**
 * Writes lyric lines as the TTML am-lyrics reads (prompt §10.2: every result
 * reaches it through its `ttml` property, so it makes no requests of its own).
 * Apple-sourced documents are passed through untouched instead; this is for
 * everything else: LRC, karaoke, JSON and plain text.
 *
 * - Word-timed lines: one `<span>` per syllable, adjacent within a word and
 *   separated by a space between words, which is how am-lyrics (like Apple)
 *   tells a syllable from a word.
 * - The answering vocal: a `ttm:role="x-bg"` span holding its own spans.
 * - Line-timed lines: a bare `<p begin end>`; am-lyrics sweeps them whole.
 * - Untimed lyrics: paragraphs with no times, which am-lyrics shows unsynced.
 * - Duets: two voices, `v1` (a person) and `v2` (typed "other", so a song that
 *   opens on the answering side starts on the right), which am-lyrics lays
 *   out with the same alternation rule as LyricAlignments.kt.
 */

const escape = (text: string) =>
  text.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

const clock = (ms: number) => (Math.max(0, ms) / 1000).toFixed(3);

function spansOf(words: LyricWord[]): string {
  return words
    .map((word) => {
      if (!word.syllables.length) {
        return `<span begin="${clock(word.startMs)}" end="${clock(word.endMs)}">${escape(word.text)}</span>`;
      }
      return word.syllables
        .map(
          (s) =>
            `<span begin="${clock(s.startMs)}" end="${clock(s.endMs)}">${escape(word.text.slice(s.startChar, s.endChar))}</span>`,
        )
        .join('');
    })
    .join(' ');
}

export function writeTtml(lines: LyricLine[], language = 'en'): string {
  const sung = lines.filter((l) => !isGap(l));
  const timed = sung.some((l) => l.timeMs > 0 || l.words.length);
  const wordTimed = sung.some((l) => l.words.length);
  const duet = sung.some((l) => l.alignment === 'end');

  const paragraphs = sung.map((l, index) => {
    const agent = duet ? ` ttm:agent="${l.alignment === 'end' ? 'v2' : 'v1'}"` : '';
    if (!timed) return `<p${agent}>${escape(l.text)}</p>`;
    const next = sung[index + 1]?.timeMs;
    if (l.words.length) {
      const lastEnd = Math.max(l.words.at(-1)!.endMs, l.background?.words.at(-1)?.endMs ?? 0);
      const background = l.background?.words.length
        ? ` <span ttm:role="x-bg">${spansOf(l.background.words)}</span>`
        : '';
      return `<p begin="${clock(l.timeMs)}" end="${clock(lastEnd)}"${agent}>${spansOf(l.words)}${background}</p>`;
    }
    // A line-timed answering vocal has no timing of its own to hang under the
    // lead, so it stays in the line, as the provider wrote it.
    const text = l.background ? `${l.text} ${l.background.text}` : l.text;
    const end = l.sungUntilMs ?? next ?? l.timeMs + 5000;
    return `<p begin="${clock(l.timeMs)}" end="${clock(Math.max(end, l.timeMs))}"${agent}>${escape(text)}</p>`;
  });

  const agents = duet ? '<ttm:agent type="person" xml:id="v1"/><ttm:agent type="other" xml:id="v2"/>' : '';
  return (
    `<tt xmlns="http://www.w3.org/ns/ttml" xmlns:ttm="http://www.w3.org/ns/ttml#metadata" ` +
    `xmlns:itunes="http://music.apple.com/lyric-ttml-internal" xml:lang="${escape(language)}" ` +
    `itunes:timing="${wordTimed ? 'Word' : timed ? 'Line' : 'None'}">` +
    `<head><metadata>${agents}</metadata></head><body><div>${paragraphs.join('')}</div></body></tt>`
  );
}

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { usePlayer } from '@/state/player';
import { queryClient } from '@/lib/queryClient';
import { onGranted } from './http';
import { forgetLyrics, lookupLyrics, type LyricsResult, type SourceState } from './repository';
import { useLyricsSettings } from './settings';
import type { LyricsSourceId } from './sources';

/** Per track: the provider the user picked in the panel, and how each provider's search went. */
interface LyricsUi {
  picked: Record<string, LyricsSourceId>;
  states: Record<string, Partial<Record<LyricsSourceId, SourceState>>>;
  pick: (videoId: string, source: LyricsSourceId | null) => void;
}

export const useLyricsUi = create<LyricsUi>()((set) => ({
  picked: {},
  states: {},
  pick: (videoId, source) =>
    set((s) => {
      const picked = { ...s.picked };
      if (source) picked[videoId] = source;
      else delete picked[videoId];
      return { picked };
    }),
}));

// A host the extension was refused for has been allowed: ask again.
onGranted(() => {
  forgetLyrics();
  void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['lyrics'] });
});

function reportState(videoId: string, source: LyricsSourceId, state: SourceState) {
  useLyricsUi.setState((s) => ({ states: { ...s.states, [videoId]: { ...s.states[videoId], [source]: state } } }));
}

/** The playing track's lyrics, from the provider chain or the provider picked for it. */
export function useLyrics() {
  const videoId = usePlayer((s) => s.nowPlaying?.videoId ?? null);
  const title = usePlayer((s) => s.nowPlaying?.title ?? '');
  const artist = usePlayer((s) => s.nowPlaying?.artist ?? '');
  const only = useLyricsUi((s) => (videoId ? s.picked[videoId] : undefined));
  const order = useLyricsSettings((s) => s.order.filter((id) => !s.disabled.includes(id)).join(','));
  const preferSyllables = useLyricsSettings((s) => s.preferSyllables);

  return useQuery<LyricsResult | null>({
    queryKey: ['lyrics', videoId, title, artist, only ?? null, order, preferSyllables],
    enabled: !!videoId && !!title,
    staleTime: Infinity,
    gcTime: 30 * 60_000,
    retry: false,
    queryFn: () => {
      const player = usePlayer.getState();
      const entry = player.queue[player.index];
      const durationSec = entry?.track.durationSec || player.nowPlaying?.durationSec || 0;
      return lookupLyrics(
        {
          videoId: videoId!,
          title,
          artist,
          durationMs: Math.round(durationSec * 1000),
          album: entry?.track.album?.name ?? null,
        },
        { ...(only && { only }), onSource: (source, state) => reportState(videoId!, source, state) },
      );
    },
  });
}

// Registers <am-lyrics>.
import '@uimaxbai/am-lyrics/am-lyrics.js';
import { Check, ChevronDown, Loader2, Minus, Settings2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { useCanvas } from '@/data/spotify/canvas';
import { getBridge } from '@/extension/bridge';
import { Menu, MenuHeader, MenuItem, MenuSeparator } from '@/components/Menu';
import { LyricClock } from '@/lyrics/clock';
import { onUngrantedChange, ungrantedOrigins } from '@/lyrics/http';
import type { SourceState } from '@/lyrics/repository';
import { enabledSources } from '@/lyrics/settings';
import { sourceById, type LyricsSourceId } from '@/lyrics/sources';
import { useLyrics, useLyricsUi } from '@/lyrics/useLyrics';
import { getAudio, usePlayer } from '@/state/player';
import { LyricsSettings } from './LyricsSettings';

type AmLyricsElement = HTMLElement & {
  currentTime: number;
  ttml?: string;
  interpolate: boolean;
  autoScroll: boolean;
  highlightColor: string;
  fontFamily?: string;
  updateComplete?: Promise<unknown>;
};

/**
 * am-lyrics' own footer offers to fetch from its own providers; ours decide
 * (prompt §10.2). It stays in the layout, only unseen: am-lyrics measures its
 * scroll range to the footer, and `display: none` collapsed that range to zero,
 * so the lyrics never scrolled.
 */
const HIDE_FOOTER = '.lyrics-footer { visibility: hidden !important; pointer-events: none !important; }';

/** The phone's lyric typeface (@font-face in styles/global.css), then the app's. */
const LYRIC_FONT = "'BitChord SF Pro Display', 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif";

let lyricFont: Promise<void> | null = null;
let lyricFontLoaded = false;

/**
 * Both weights, fetched once. am-lyrics measures its lines for the scroll and
 * the wipe, so it's only built once the face is in: built earlier, it laid
 * out in the fallback and then jumped when the font arrived. A slow network
 * gives up after 1.5 s and lets the fallback show.
 */
function loadLyricFont(): Promise<void> {
  lyricFont ??= Promise.race([
    Promise.all([document.fonts.load(`700 28px ${LYRIC_FONT}`), document.fonts.load(`400 28px ${LYRIC_FONT}`)]),
    new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500)),
  ])
    .catch(() => undefined)
    .then(() => {
      lyricFontLoaded = true;
    });
  return lyricFont;
}

function useLyricFont(): boolean {
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(lyricFontLoaded);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready) void loadLyricFont().then(() => setReady(true));
  }, [ready]);
  return ready;
}

/**
 * am-lyrics fades the four lines either side of the current one (0.7, 0.58,
 * 0.46) and leaves every line past them at its base 0.8, so the fifth line on
 * came back brighter. Those stay at the farthest step. Gaps keep their own
 * opacity, and the library's !important rules (scrolling by hand, unsynced
 * lyrics) still win.
 */
const FAR_LINES =
  '.lyrics-line:not(.active):not(.pre-active):not(.lyrics-activest):not(.post-active-line):not(.next-active-line)' +
  ':not(.prev-2):not(.prev-3):not(.next-2):not(.next-3):not(.lyrics-gap) { opacity: 0.46; }';

/**
 * The full-screen player's sizing (report §7): its line size, set on the host
 * by breakpoint, replaces all three of am-lyrics' container tiers, and the
 * current line sits a third of the way down. Scoped to `data-full`, so the
 * side panel keeps the library's own sizes.
 */
const FULL_SIZE =
  ':host([data-full]) .lyrics-container { --lyplus-font-size-base: var(--bitchord-lyric-size, 34px);' +
  ' --am-lyrics-line-height: 1.2; --am-lyrics-line-spacing: calc(var(--bitchord-lyric-size, 34px) * 0.7);' +
  ' --lyrics-scroll-padding-top: 30%; --am-lyrics-inline-padding: 0px; }';

/**
 * am-lyrics, exactly as it is, fed our TTML and a steered clock (prompt §10.2).
 * The clock reads the media time each frame, stamps the reading with when it
 * was taken, and is told about every seek and track change: the "lyric clock
 * dates readings by sample time" lesson. No React state per frame: the time is
 * written straight onto the element.
 */
function LyricsView({ ttml, full }: { ttml: string; full: boolean }) {
  const host = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const element = useRef<AmLyricsElement | null>(null);
  const deck = usePlayer((s) => s.deck);
  const videoId = usePlayer((s) => s.nowPlaying?.videoId);

  // Created by hand, with its TTML set before it's attached: am-lyrics starts
  // loading the moment it connects, and through React the properties arrive
  // a beat later, so its first load went to its own providers with no title
  // and finished after ours, wiping it.
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = document.createElement('am-lyrics') as AmLyricsElement;
    el.ttml = ttml;
    el.interpolate = true;
    el.autoScroll = true;
    el.highlightColor = '#ffffff';
    el.fontFamily = LYRIC_FONT;
    el.className = 'block min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden [--am-lyrics-highlight-color:#fff]';
    el.toggleAttribute('data-full', full);
    const onLineClick = (event: Event) => {
      const timestamp = (event as CustomEvent<{ timestamp: number }>).detail?.timestamp;
      if (typeof timestamp === 'number') usePlayer.getState().seek(timestamp / 1000);
    };
    el.addEventListener('line-click', onLineClick);
    host.current?.append(el);
    element.current = el;
    const unmounted = new AbortController();
    void Promise.resolve(el.updateComplete).then(() => {
      const root = el.shadowRoot;
      if (!root) return;
      const sheet = new CSSStyleSheet();
      sheet.replaceSync(HIDE_FOOTER + FAR_LINES + FULL_SIZE);
      root.adoptedStyleSheets = [...root.adoptedStyleSheets, sheet];
      // The full-screen column fades its top edge, but am-lyrics' toolbar
      // (romanize, translate, download) sits at the top of the same scroller
      // until the lines push it away. The fade grows with the scroll instead,
      // so the toolbar is never under it.
      const scroller = root.querySelector('.lyrics-container');
      const target = host.current;
      if (!full || !scroller || !target) return;
      const fade = () => target.style.setProperty('--lyrics-top-fade', `${Math.min(scroller.scrollTop, 80)}px`);
      fade();
      scroller.addEventListener('scroll', fade, { passive: true, signal: unmounted.signal });
    });
    return () => {
      unmounted.abort();
      el.removeEventListener('line-click', onLineClick);
      el.remove();
      element.current = null;
    };
    // Mounted once; a new provider's TTML is handed over below.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (element.current && element.current.ttml !== ttml) element.current.ttml = ttml;
  }, [ttml]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = getAudio();
    const el = element.current;
    if (!audio || !el) return;
    const clock = new LyricClock(audio.currentTime * 1000);
    let discontinuity = 0;
    let frame = 0;
    const tick = () => {
      const now = performance.now();
      // The reading and its stamp are taken together.
      el.currentTime = clock.frame(now, Math.trunc(audio.currentTime * 1000), now, discontinuity);
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    const hold = () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      const ms = audio.currentTime * 1000;
      clock.hold(ms, performance.now());
      el.currentTime = ms;
    };
    const resume = () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      clock.restart();
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    const onSeeking = () => {
      discontinuity++;
      if (audio.paused) hold();
    };
    audio.addEventListener('seeking', onSeeking);
    audio.addEventListener('seeked', onSeeking);
    audio.addEventListener('pause', hold);
    audio.addEventListener('play', resume);
    if (audio.paused) hold();
    else resume();
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      audio.removeEventListener('seeking', onSeeking);
      audio.removeEventListener('seeked', onSeeking);
      audio.removeEventListener('pause', hold);
      audio.removeEventListener('play', resume);
    };
  }, [deck, videoId, ttml]);

  // am-lyrics renders and scrolls itself; it only needs the space. Full screen fades it out at the top and bottom.
  return (
    <div
      ref={host}
      className={
        full
          ? 'flex min-h-0 flex-1 [mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000_var(--lyrics-top-fade,0px),#000_50%,transparent)]'
          : 'flex min-h-0 flex-1'
      }
    />
  );
}

function useUngranted(): string[] {
  return useSyncExternalStore(onUngrantedChange, () => [...ungrantedOrigins].join(','), () => '')
    .split(',')
    .filter(Boolean);
}

const NO_STATES: Partial<Record<LyricsSourceId, SourceState>> = {};

/** The provider picker: which provider these lyrics are from, and the others' answers for this track. */
function ProviderPicker({ current, full }: { current: LyricsSourceId | null; full: boolean }) {
  const videoId = usePlayer((s) => s.nowPlaying?.videoId ?? '');
  const states = useLyricsUi((s) => s.states[videoId]) ?? NO_STATES;
  const picked = useLyricsUi((s) => s.picked[videoId]);
  const pick = useLyricsUi((s) => s.pick);
  const [anchor, setAnchor] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(false);
  const close = useCallback(() => setAnchor(null), []);
  const label = current ? sourceById(current)?.label : 'Lyrics';

  return (
    // In full screen the picker sits quietly above the lines, shown on hover.
    <div
      className={
        full
          ? 'flex items-center justify-between pb-1 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-200 group-hover/panel:opacity-100 focus-within:opacity-100'
          : 'flex items-center justify-between px-4 pt-4 pb-1'
      }
    >
      <button
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-[8px] px-2 py-1 type-callout-emphasized text-secondary hover:bg-quinary"
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        onClick={(e) => setAnchor(e.currentTarget)}
      >
        <span>{label}</span>
        <ChevronDown size={14} />
      </button>
      <button
        className="grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-[8px] text-secondary hover:bg-quinary"
        aria-label="Lyric settings"
        onClick={() => setSettings(true)}
      >
        <Settings2 size={16} />
      </button>
      {anchor && (
        <Menu anchor={anchor} placement="below-end" onClose={close} label="Lyrics provider">
          <MenuItem checked={!picked} onSelect={() => (close(), pick(videoId, null))}>
            Best available
          </MenuItem>
          <MenuSeparator />
          <MenuHeader>Providers</MenuHeader>
          {enabledSources().map((id) => {
            const state = states[id];
            return (
              <MenuItem
                key={id}
                checked={picked === id}
                trailing={
                  state === 'pending' ? (
                    <Loader2 size={13} className="animate-spin" />
                  ) : state === 'found' ? (
                    <Check size={13} />
                  ) : state === 'missing' ? (
                    <Minus size={13} />
                  ) : undefined
                }
                onSelect={() => (close(), pick(videoId, id))}
              >
                {sourceById(id)?.label}
              </MenuItem>
            );
          })}
          <MenuSeparator />
          <MenuItem onSelect={() => (close(), setSettings(true))}>Lyric Settings…</MenuItem>
        </Menu>
      )}
      {settings && <LyricsSettings onClose={() => setSettings(false)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function PermissionNotice({ origins }: { origins: string[] }) {
  const names = origins.map((o) => new URL(o).host.replace(/^www\./, ''));
  return (
    <div className="mx-4 my-1.5 flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[10px] bg-quinary px-2.5 py-2 type-callout text-secondary">
      <span>
        {names.slice(0, 2).join(', ')}
        {names.length > 2 ? ` and ${names.length - 2} more` : ''} need the extension’s permission.
      </span>
      <button
        className="flex-none type-callout-emphasized text-key"
        // The notice stays until the extension confirms the grant (checked when this tab comes back).
        onClick={() => void getBridge()?.call('lyrics.requestPermissions', { origins })}
      >
        Allow
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The track's Spotify Canvas behind the lyrics, dimmed so they stay legible.
 * Muted and looping, it fades in once it can play and pauses with the music.
 *
 * The blur runs on a quarter-size video that is then scaled up 4×: a 3px blur
 * there reads as about 12px on screen for a sixteenth of the pixels, which is
 * what keeps a blurred, playing video cheap. The 5% overscan on each side
 * keeps the soft edges out of view.
 */
function CanvasBackdrop({ url }: { url: string }) {
  const video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const playing = usePlayer((s) => s.status === 'playing' || s.status === 'buffering');
  useEffect(() => setReady(false), [url]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = video.current;
    if (!el || !ready) return;
    if (playing) void el.play().catch(() => undefined);
    else el.pause();
  }, [playing, ready]);
  return (
    <video
      ref={video}
      key={url}
      className="absolute top-[-5%] left-[-5%] -z-1 size-[27.5%] origin-[0_0] scale-400 object-cover opacity-0 blur-[3px] transition-opacity duration-600 [mask-image:linear-gradient(to_bottom,rgb(0_0_0/1),rgb(0_0_0/0.85))] data-ready:opacity-85"
      data-ready={ready || undefined}
      src={url}
      muted
      loop
      playsInline
      preload="auto"
      aria-hidden="true"
      onCanPlay={() => setReady(true)}
      onError={() => setReady(false)}
    />
  );
}

const panel = 'group/panel relative isolate flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden';
// The full-screen player's column (report §7): lines 26px, then 30px from 980px, 36px from 1320px and 42px from 1680px.
const fullSizes =
  '[--bitchord-lyric-size:26px] min-[980px]:[--bitchord-lyric-size:30px] min-[1320px]:[--bitchord-lyric-size:36px] min-[1680px]:[--bitchord-lyric-size:42px]';

/**
 * The lyrics, with their provider picker and empty states: the side panel
 * (report §7), and the right-hand column of the full-screen player, where the
 * lines are larger and the player's mesh stands in for the Canvas.
 */
export function LyricsPanel({ variant = 'panel' }: { variant?: 'panel' | 'full' }) {
  const lyrics = useLyrics();
  const hasTrack = usePlayer((s) => s.nowPlaying !== null);
  const ungranted = useUngranted();
  const canvas = useCanvas();
  const fontReady = useLyricFont();
  const result = lyrics.data;
  const full = variant === 'full';
  const empty = full
    ? 'flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 text-center type-title-3 text-secondary'
    : 'flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 pb-20 text-center type-[400_12px/16px] text-secondary';
  const emptyTitle = full ? 'type-title-1-emphasized text-primary' : 'type-[600_12px/16px]';

  return (
    <div className={full ? `${panel} ${fullSizes}` : panel}>
      {canvas && variant === 'panel' && <CanvasBackdrop url={canvas} />}
      <ProviderPicker current={result?.source ?? null} full={full} />
      {/* Only worth raising when nothing was found: then the hosts behind the extension might have it. */}
      {ungranted.length > 0 && !result && !lyrics.isFetching && <PermissionNotice origins={ungranted} />}
      {!hasTrack ? (
        <div className={empty}>
          <p className={emptyTitle}>No lyrics available</p>
          <p>Play a song to see its lyrics here.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (lyrics.isPending && lyrics.fetchStatus !== 'idle') || (result && !fontReady) ? (
        <div className={empty}>
          <Loader2 size={20} className="animate-spin" />
        </div>
      ) : result ? (
        <LyricsView ttml={result.ttml} full={full} />
      ) : (
        <div className={empty}>
          <p className={emptyTitle}>No lyrics available</p>
          <p>None of the lyric providers has this song. Try another in the list above.</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { getBridge } from '@/extension/bridge';
import { LYRIC_EXTENSION_ORIGINS as EXTENSION_ORIGINS } from '@/lyrics/http';
import { useLyricsSettings } from '@/lyrics/settings';
import { sourceById } from '@/lyrics/sources';

const section = 'mx-1 mt-[18px] mb-1.5 type-subhead-emphasized uppercase text-secondary';
const note = 'mx-1 mb-2 type-callout text-secondary';
const group = 'overflow-hidden rounded-[10px] bg-quinary';
const row = 'flex items-center gap-2 py-2 pr-2.5 pl-3';
const toggle = 'flex min-w-0 flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5';
const checkbox = 'size-4 accent-key';
const moveButton = 'grid size-[26px] place-items-center rounded-[6px] text-secondary enabled:hover:bg-quaternary disabled:opacity-30';

/**
 * Lyric providers, as the desktop's settings have them: switch each on or
 * off, put them in order, prefer syllable timing, and the PaxSenix key. Plus
 * the one thing only the web needs: letting the extension reach the hosts a
 * page can't.
 */
export function LyricsSettings({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const { order, disabled, preferSyllables, paxsenixKey, setEnabled, move, setPreferSyllables, setPaxsenixKey, reset } =
    useLyricsSettings();
  const [granted, setGranted] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
  const [key, setKey] = useState(paxsenixKey);

  useEffect(() => {
    const check = () =>
      void getBridge()
        ?.call('lyrics.permissions', { origins: EXTENSION_ORIGINS })
        .then((r) => setGranted(r.granted))
        .catch(() => setGranted(null));
    check();
    window.addEventListener('focus', check);
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === 'Escape' && onClose();
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('focus', check);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    };
  }, [onClose]);

  const missing = granted ? EXTENSION_ORIGINS.filter((o) => !granted.includes(o)) : [];

  return createPortal(
    // A modal (report §8): scrim, 14px card radius, fade with a slight zoom, 30px close circle.
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-(--z-modal) grid animate-fade place-items-center bg-scrim" onPointerDown={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
      <div
        className="flex max-h-[min(720px,calc(100vh-48px))] w-[min(520px,calc(100vw-32px))] animate-zoom flex-col rounded-[14px] bg-page shadow-glass"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label="Lyric settings"
      >
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 pt-[18px] pb-2">
          <h2 className="type-title-2-emphasized">Lyrics</h2>
          <button className="grid size-[30px] place-items-center rounded-full bg-[#333336] text-secondary" aria-label="Close" onClick={onClose}>
            <X size={16} />
          </button>
        </header>

        <div className="overflow-y-auto px-5 pb-5">
          <h3 className={section}>Providers</h3>
          <p className={note}>Asked all at once; the first in this order with word-timed lyrics wins.</p>
          <ol className={group}>
            {order.map((id, index) => {
              const source = sourceById(id)!;
              const on = !disabled.includes(id);
              return (
                <li key={id} className={`${row} [&+&]:border-t-[0.5px] [&+&]:border-t-divider`}>
                  <label className={toggle}>
                    <input type="checkbox" className={checkbox} checked={on} onChange={(e) => setEnabled(id, e.currentTarget.checked)} />
                    <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                      <span className="type-body-emphasized">{source.label}</span>
                      <span className="truncate type-callout text-secondary">{source.detail}</span>
                    </span>
                  </label>
                  <span className="flex gap-0.5">
                    <button className={moveButton} aria-label={`Move ${source.label} up`} disabled={index === 0} onClick={() => move(id, -1)}>
                      <ArrowUp size={14} />
                    </button>
                    <button className={moveButton} aria-label={`Move ${source.label} down`} disabled={index === order.length - 1} onClick={() => move(id, 1)}>
                      <ArrowDown size={14} />
                    </button>
                  </span>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>

          <label className={`${group} ${toggle} py-2 pr-2.5 pl-3`}>
            <input type="checkbox" className={checkbox} checked={preferSyllables} onChange={(e) => setPreferSyllables(e.currentTarget.checked)} />
            <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
              <span className="type-body-emphasized">Prefer syllable timing</span>
              <span className="truncate type-callout text-secondary">Keep looking past a line-timed answer for a word-timed one.</span>
            </span>
          </label>

          <h3 className={section}>Extension access</h3>
          {granted === null ? (
            <p className={note}>KuGou, Musixmatch, Genius and PaxSenix need the BitChord extension.</p>
          ) : missing.length ? (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <p className={note}>
                KuGou, Musixmatch, Genius and PaxSenix don’t let web pages ask them directly. Allow the extension to,
                once.
              </p>
              <button className="flex-none rounded-[14px] bg-key px-3.5 py-1.5 type-callout-emphasized text-white" onClick={() => void getBridge()?.call('lyrics.requestPermissions', { origins: missing })}>
                Allow
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className={note}>All providers are reachable.</p>
          )}

          <h3 className={section}>PaxSenix key</h3>
          <input
            className="w-full rounded-[10px] border-0 bg-quinary px-3 py-2 type-body text-primary"
            type="password"
            placeholder="For PaxSenix: Spotify and Musixmatch"
            value={key}
            onChange={(e) => setKey(e.currentTarget.value)}
            onBlur={() => setPaxsenixKey(key)}
            autoComplete="off"
          />

          <button className="mt-[18px] type-callout-emphasized text-key" onClick={reset}>
            Restore Defaults
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
}
